title: Senior Full-Stack SaaS Developer
description:
About the Project

We are building a SaaS platform for small-business owners that guides users through complex business setup and operating decisions in a simple, step-by-step experience.

This is not a basic website, online course, or static checklist. The application will use conditional decision trees, persistent user profiles, saved progress, personalized resources, dynamic dashboards, and interconnected workflows.

We already have substantial product planning completed, including detailed workflow logic, decision trees, data requirements, content, and an early prototype. We are looking for an experienced developer who can help turn this into a scalable production application.

What the MVP needs to do

Users should be able to create an account and move through a guided multi-step experience. The system should ask questions based on previous answers, skip irrelevant sections, save information so users don’t repeatedly enter the same data, surface personalized resources and links, track completion/readiness, and generate a personalized dashboard showing outstanding actions and next steps.

The application will eventually support multiple connected products/workflows, so the architecture should be designed for expansion rather than hard-coded around one checklist.

Core functionality includes:

• User authentication and persistent profiles
• SaaS dashboard and progress tracking
• Conditional decision-tree/workflow engine
• Dynamic questions based on previous answers
• Cross-step data reuse and prefilling
• Conditional step skipping/applicability rules
• Statuses such as Complete, Needs Attention, Owner to Confirm, and Not Applicable
• Personalized resource/link recommendations
• Saved user resource library
• Personalized next-action/readiness dashboard
• Admin ability to manage questions, resources, links, workflow logic, and content without requiring a developer for routine updates
• Secure relational database architecture
• Responsive desktop/mobile experience
• Subscription/payment architecture
• Foundation for future API and AI integrations

The user experience is extremely important.

We are intentionally building a guided resource, not an online class. Users should not encounter walls of educational content. The experience should feel more like:

Question → Decision → Brief Explanation → Personalized Resource/Action → Saved Result → Next Step

The platform must remember what it already knows about the user and use those answers throughout later workflows.

Who we’re looking for

We want a senior developer or small development team with demonstrated experience building real SaaS applications—not primarily brochure websites or WordPress sites.

Strong candidates should have experience with modern front-end development such as React/Next.js or comparable technology; relational databases such as PostgreSQL; backend/API architecture; authentication and permissions; SaaS dashboards; complex conditional workflows; payment/subscription integrations; secure production deployment; and maintainable application architecture.

Experience with Supabase or a comparable backend platform is a plus. Experience building configurable workflow/rules engines, admin systems, AI-enabled SaaS products, or vertical SaaS is especially valuable.

Important: We do not want hundreds of questions and decision rules individually hard-coded into the UI if a more maintainable, data-driven architecture can be created. Please explain how you would approach this.

When applying, please answer these questions:

1. Show us 2–3 SaaS applications you personally helped build and explain exactly what you built on each.
2. Have you built an application with conditional workflows, branching questionnaires, rules engines, or dynamic forms? Please describe it.
3. How would you architect a system where questions, resources, and workflow rules can be updated without redeploying the entire application?
4. How would you ensure information entered in one workflow can automatically populate later workflows without creating duplicate/conflicting data?
5. What technology stack would you recommend for this project, and why?
6. What would you build first to validate the architecture before developing the entire platform?
7. What would you need from us before you could provide a reliable MVP estimate?
8. Will you personally write the code, or will any portion be outsourced/subcontracted? If others will participate, describe exactly who will be working on the project.

Please begin your proposal with the words “GUIDED WORKFLOW” so we know you read the complete posting.

Generic proposals will not be considered.

Project status

Product strategy, workflows, decision logic, content requirements, and an early prototype already exist. Detailed proprietary materials will be shared with shortlisted candidates rather than included publicly.

Engagement

Initial engagement: MVP development
Potential: Long-term development and continued product expansion

We value thoughtful architecture, communication, documentation, and product judgment more than simply choosing the lowest bid.

title: Senior Backend Developer for Single-Tenant Headless Asset & Syndication Hub
description:
Project Overview:
We are building a dedicated, single-tenant headless content and asset hub to manage a legacy streetwear brand's historical event photos, media catalogs, and founder profile data from scratch. This system will serve as the master control node for our digital footprint—storing structured historical assets and pushing them outward to external data nodes and syndication endpoints.

Core Technical Requirements:
1. Single-Tenant Architecture: The system must be built for a single entity/brand. No complex multi-tenant database partitioning or multi-client overhead is required. Clean, isolated, lightning-fast single-brand data modeling (Node.js/TypeScript with PostgreSQL or Payload CMS).
2. Asset & Metadata Management: Robust database schemas to handle high-resolution event imagery, historical timelines, press mentions, and custom categorical tagging so files retain full structural context.
3. Tag-Filtered JSON REST APIs: Expose secure, high-performance REST endpoints that allow external developers or syndication nodes to query assets and data packets filtered strictly by tags, dates, or media types.
4. Event-Driven Webhook Dispatcher: A reliable webhook delivery system in Node.js featuring payload verification, automated retry logic, and error logging to instantly push published updates and new asset alerts out to external publication and syndication endpoints.

Deliverables:
- Fully functional single-tenant backend repository.
- Configured and documented JSON REST API endpoints with tag filtering.
- Working webhook dispatcher with built-in retry and failure management.
- Deployment scripts and clean technical documentation.

Application Instructions:
Do not send a generic AI template response. In your proposal, explicitly state:
1. Your preferred stack (e.g., custom Express/Node.js vs Payload CMS) and why it fits a single-tenant media pipeline.
2. How you plan to architect the webhook retry logic to handle failed external network pings.
Proposals ignoring these specific technical questions will be automatically ignored.

title: Technical Generalist - Web Infrastructure, WordPress, and Marketing Platforms
description:
We run technical operations for a small US health-education business. The estate is about twenty WordPress sites on a single Ubuntu server behind Cloudflare, plus Shopify storefronts, email marketing, analytics, and custom glue code. 

These are production systems: real customers log into membership sites and receive essential communications.

No two months look alike. Recent work has included migrating the estate between hosting providers, building custom monitoring from scratch, writing a PHP email-sequencing engine, and rebuilding outbound mail authentication. 

Underneath the projects runs a steady baseline of 
maintenance.

Our current maintainer is unavailable for six months. We have thorough documentation (runbooks, estate inventories) and a dedicated handover period.

Project work

- Moving sites and services between providers with minimal downtime
- Integrating marketing platforms: email automation, quiz tools, storefront apps
- Small amounts of custom PHP and shell
- Performance work: caching, database, page builders
 - Deploying and documenting new infrastructure
 - Baseline maintenance (this cannot slip)
- WordPress core, plugin, theme, and license updates across the estate
- Ubuntu hosts: Apache, PHP-FPM, MariaDB, Exim, service health, disk, certificates
- Cloudflare DNS, WAF rules, redirects, tunnels
- Email deliverability: SPF, DKIM, DMARC
- Security triage, backup verification and restore testing, monthly maintenance passes

What we're looking for
- Breadth over depth. A technical generalist comfortable at the terminal who learns unfamiliar systems quickly and gives an honest self-assessment. 
- You can run Linux without a control panel, scope complex work and sequence it correctly, troubleshoot from logs and config files rather than forum fixes, and verify outcomes rather than commands (quiet failures are the expensive ones). - Document as you go: the next person has to follow your work.

We work carefully in production. Changes are rehearsed, reversible, and verified. Back up first. Ask before deleting data, dropping databases, or changing DNS.

Terms
- Fixed-term cover: early September 2026 through March 2027
- Handover in end of August. Tell us your earliest start date.
- $45-70/hour depending on coverage and experience
- We need to reach you fast if critical services fail, so tell us your timezone and typical overlap with US Central
- Possible ongoing low-hour holiday cover afterward (not a promise)
- No subcontracting.
- No templated proposals. Include the word "logrotate" so we know you read this.

title: Technical Generalist - Web Infrastructure, WordPress, and Marketing Platforms
description:
We run technical operations for a small US health-education business. The estate is about twenty WordPress sites on a single Ubuntu server behind Cloudflare, plus Shopify storefronts, email marketing, analytics, and custom glue code. 

These are production systems: real customers log into membership sites and receive essential communications.

No two months look alike. Recent work has included migrating the estate between hosting providers, building custom monitoring from scratch, writing a PHP email-sequencing engine, and rebuilding outbound mail authentication. 

Underneath the projects runs a steady baseline of 
maintenance.

Our current maintainer is unavailable for six months. We have thorough documentation (runbooks, estate inventories) and a dedicated handover period.

Project work

- Moving sites and services between providers with minimal downtime
- Integrating marketing platforms: email automation, quiz tools, storefront apps
- Small amounts of custom PHP and shell
- Performance work: caching, database, page builders
 - Deploying and documenting new infrastructure

- Ubuntu hosts: Apache, PHP-FPM, MariaDB, Exim, service health, disk, certificates
- Cloudflare DNS, WAF rules, redirects, tunnels
- Email deliverability: SPF, DKIM, DMARC
- Security triage, backup verification and restore testing, monthly maintenance passes

What we're looking for
- Breadth over depth. A technical generalist comfortable at the terminal who learns unfamiliar systems quickly and gives an honest self-assessment. 
- You can run Linux without a control panel, scope complex work and sequence it correctly, troubleshoot from logs and config files rather than forum fixes, and verify outcomes rather than commands (quiet failures are the expensive ones). - Document as you go: the next person has to follow your work.

We work carefully in production. Changes are rehearsed, reversible, and verified. Back up first. Ask before deleting data, dropping databases, or changing DNS.

Terms
- Fixed-term cover: early September 2026 through March 2027
- Handover in end of August. Tell us your earliest start date.
- $45-70/hour depending on coverage and experience
- We need to reach you fast if critical services fail, so tell us your timezone and typical overlap with US Central

Project Overview:
We are building a dedicated, single-tenant headless content and asset hub to manage a legacy streetwear brand's historical event photos, media catalogs, and founder profile data from scratch. This system will serve as the master control node for our digital footprint—storing structured historical assets and pushing them outward to external data nodes and syndication endpoints.

Core Technical Requirements:
1. Single-Tenant Architecture: The system must be built for a single entity/brand. No complex multi-tenant database partitioning or multi-client overhead is required. Clean, isolated, lightning-fast single-brand data modeling (Node.js/TypeScript with PostgreSQL or Payload CMS).
2. Asset & Metadata Management: Robust database schemas to handle high-resolution event imagery, historical timelines, press mentions, and custom categorical tagging so files retain full structural context.
3. Tag-Filtered JSON REST APIs: Expose secure, high-performance REST endpoints that allow external developers or syndication nodes to query assets and data packets filtered strictly by tags, dates, or media types.
4. Event-Driven Webhook Dispatcher: A reliable webhook delivery system in Node.js featuring payload verification, automated retry logic, and error logging to instantly push published updates and new asset alerts out to external publication and syndication endpoints.

Deliverables:
- Fully functional single-tenant backend repository.
- Configured and documented JSON REST API endpoints with tag filtering.
- Working webhook dispatcher with built-in retry and failure management.
- Deployment scripts and clean technical documentation.

Application Instructions:
Do not send a generic AI template response. In your proposal, explicitly state:
1. Your preferred stack (e.g., custom Express/Node.js vs Payload CMS) and why it fits a single-tenant media pipeline.
2. How you plan to architect the webhook retry logic to handle failed external network pings.

title: Full-Stack/API Developer Needed — AI Physician Authority Scanner MVP
description:
# Full-Stack/API Developer Needed — AI Physician Authority Scanner MVP

## Project Overview

I own a video marketing company focused specifically on physicians, and I am building an internal tool called a **Physician Authority Scanner**.

The goal is simple:

I enter a physician's:

* Name
* Specialty
* City
* Website

The tool automatically analyzes the physician's digital presence across search, website content, video, social media, reviews, and competitors, then produces a structured **Physician Authority Score**.

I already have the scoring methodology, API accounts, data structure, and detailed product documentation.

I am NOT looking to build a polished SaaS application yet.

The first goal is to build a **working internal MVP/proof of concept** that I can test on approximately 5–20 physicians.

---

# What the Tool Needs to Analyze

## 1. Google Search Presence

Analyze relevant Google searches around the physician's:

* Specialty
* Procedures
* Conditions treated
* Location
* Name

We want to understand how visible the physician is when patients search for their expertise.

---

## 2. Google Maps & Reputation

Collect information such as:

* Maps/local presence
* Rating
* Review volume
* Review recency
* Relevant competitor comparisons

---

## 3. Physician Website

Crawl the physician's website and identify:

* Physician bio
* Conditions treated
* Procedures
* Patient education
* FAQs
* Blog/resources
* Relevant educational content

The system should determine how well the physician answers important patient questions online.

---

# 4. Patient Question Analysis

The system should create approximately **20–30 important patient questions** based on the physician's specialty, procedures, website, and search data.

Example:

For a foot/ankle surgeon:

* Do I need bunion surgery?
* How long is bunion surgery recovery?
* Can bunions be treated without surgery?
* When can I walk after surgery?

The system should then determine which questions the physician currently answers through their website, video, and social content.

---

# 5. YouTube Presence

Identify the physician's YouTube presence where possible and analyze:

* Educational videos
* Publishing activity
* Topics covered
* Physician-led videos
* Patient-question coverage
* Search visibility

---

# 6. Instagram Presence

Identify the physician's professional Instagram presence where reliably available.

We are interested in signals such as:

* Is there a professional account?
* Is the account active?
* Is the physician appearing in video?
* How much content is educational versus promotional?
* What medical topics are being discussed?
* Publishing consistency
* Patient-question/topic coverage

I do NOT want follower count to be the primary measurement.

The goal is to evaluate whether the physician is actually using Instagram to demonstrate expertise.

---

# 7. LinkedIn Presence

Identify the physician's professional LinkedIn presence where publicly and compliantly accessible.

Possible signals include:

* Profile presence
* Professional positioning
* Specialty/expertise consistency
* Recent thought-leadership/content presence
* Physician-authored educational content

I understand LinkedIn's official API/public-data access may be more restrictive than other platforms.

I want the developer to build this portion using compliant, maintainable methods and gracefully mark unavailable information as **unknown** rather than inventing or forcing data.

---

# 8. Competitor / Market Comparison

The system should identify approximately **5 relevant physicians** in the same specialty/market.

We want basic comparisons such as:

* Search visibility
* Review presence
* Website educational content
* YouTube/video presence
* Social/content activity

The first version does NOT need to perform an extremely expensive full analysis of every competitor.

---

# 9. Authority Scoring

I already have a scoring methodology.

The Authority Score will include areas such as:

* Search Authority
* Reputation Authority
* Educational Authority
* Video & Social Authority
* Website Authority

AI should NOT simply decide:

 "This physician deserves a score of 73."

AI will be used for structured tasks such as:

* Classifying website pages
* Identifying educational content
* Matching content with patient questions
* Classifying videos/social content
* Topic clustering
* Determining whether content is physician-led
* Identifying content gaps

The final Authority Score should be calculated using predefined scoring rules/formulas.

---

# Important Data Rule

The system must distinguish between:

### Confirmed Missing

Example:

We verified that the physician does not have a YouTube channel.

and:

### Unknown

Example:

The system could not confidently determine which YouTube channel belongs to the physician.

Unknown information should NOT automatically become a zero.

---

# API / Technology Accounts Already Available

I have already created accounts for:

* DataForSEO
* Firecrawl
* OpenAI API
* YouTube Data API
* Google Cloud
* PageSpeed Insights
* Supabase
* GitHub

I am open to recommendations for Instagram/LinkedIn data acquisition, but I do not want unnecessary expensive SaaS subscriptions added without a good reason.

---

# What I Need Built First

I need a simple internal interface.

### Input

Doctor Name:

Specialty:

City:

Website:

### RUN SCAN

The system then performs the research automatically.

---

# Example Output

## Dr. Example

### Physician Authority Score

**67 / 100**

### Search Authority

72

### Reputation Authority

81

### Educational Authority

49

### Video & Social Authority

38

### Website Authority

77

---

## Patient Education Coverage

**12 of 30 important patient questions answered**

18 opportunities identified.

---

## Video & Social Presence

YouTube:

14 educational videos identified

Instagram:

Active account; educational presence detected

LinkedIn:

Professional presence identified

---

## Market Comparison

Your Position:

**#4 of 6 physicians analyzed**

---

## Biggest Authority Opportunity

**Patient Education Video**

18 important patient questions currently have no meaningful physician-led video answer identified.

---

# Evidence

I also need an internal way to inspect the underlying data that produced the results.

For example:

* Search query
* Ranking
* Page URL
* Video URL
* Social profile
* Review data
* Source
* Classification
* Confidence

It does NOT need to be a beautiful interface initially.

Accuracy and reliability are more important.

---

# Preferred Technology

I am open to recommendations.

A possible stack could include:

* Python / FastAPI
* TypeScript / Next.js
* Supabase / PostgreSQL
* OpenAI API
* DataForSEO
* Firecrawl

I care more about clean architecture than a specific framework.

---

# Project Ownership

All code must be committed to a private GitHub repository owned by my company.

API accounts remain under my ownership.

API keys must never be hard-coded into the application or committed to GitHub.

---

# MVP Scope

This project is specifically for the **internal proof of concept**.

I do NOT currently need:

* Customer login system
* Billing
* Stripe
* Mobile app
* Complex admin dashboard
* CRM integration
* Automated email campaigns
* Advanced client dashboard
* Highly polished UI
* Enterprise-scale infrastructure

If the MVP works well, I intend to continue development into a polished public-facing product.

---

# Budget

**$1,000–$2,000 fixed price for the initial MVP**

I prefer milestone-based development.

There is potential for additional work if the prototype performs well.

---

# Developer Requirements

I am looking for someone strong in:

* API integration
* Python and/or TypeScript
* OpenAI API
* Structured AI outputs / JSON
* Supabase/PostgreSQL
* Data collection
* Web crawling
* API error handling
* Data normalization
* Scoring systems

SEO/search-data experience is a major plus.

Experience with Instagram or LinkedIn data integrations is also helpful.

Healthcare experience is NOT required.

---

# Please Answer These Questions

### 1.

Tell me about a project where you combined several APIs/data sources into one application.

### 2.

How would you build this so that one API failing does not cause the physician to incorrectly receive a zero?

### 3.

How would you structure the OpenAI portion so AI classifies the information but does not arbitrarily control the score?

### 4.

Have you worked with:

DataForSEO, Firecrawl, Supabase, OpenAI API, YouTube Data API, Instagram APIs/data, or LinkedIn APIs/data?

Please specify which.

### 5.

What would you recommend for reliably analyzing public Instagram and LinkedIn presence while remaining compliant with platform restrictions?

### 6.

What technology stack would you use for this MVP?

### 7.

Can you complete the work inside a GitHub repository that I own?

8.

Will you personally build the project, or will it be delegated?

9.

Please provide 1–3 examples of technically similar projects you have built.

 10.

Please begin your proposal with:

PHYSICIAN AUTHORITY

so I know you read the complete project description.



I have detailed technical specifications, scoring methodology, and data contracts available for the developer selected for the project.

title: Full-Stack/API Developer Needed — AI Physician Authority Scanner MVP
description:
# Full-Stack/API Developer Needed — AI Physician Authority Scanner MVP

## Project Overview

I own a video marketing company focused specifically on physicians, and I am building an internal tool called a **Physician Authority Scanner**.

The goal is simple:

I enter a physician's:

* Name
* Specialty
* City
* Website

The tool automatically analyzes the physician's digital presence across search, website content, video, social media, reviews, and competitors, then produces a structured **Physician Authority Score**.

I already have the scoring methodology, API accounts, data structure, and detailed product documentation.

I am NOT looking to build a polished SaaS application yet.

The first goal is to build a **working internal MVP/proof of concept** that I can test on approximately 5–20 physicians.

---

# What the Tool Needs to Analyze

## 1. Google Search Presence

Analyze relevant Google searches around the physician's:

* Specialty
* Procedures
* Conditions treated
* Location
* Name

We want to understand how visible the physician is when patients search for their expertise.

---

## 2. Google Maps & Reputation

Collect information such as:

* Maps/local presence
* Rating
* Review volume
* Review recency
* Relevant competitor comparisons

---

## 3. Physician Website

Crawl the physician's website and identify:

* Physician bio
* Conditions treated
* Procedures
* Patient education
* FAQs
* Blog/resources
* Relevant educational content

The system should determine how well the physician answers important patient questions online.

---

# 4. Patient Question Analysis

The system should create approximately **20–30 important patient questions** based on the physician's specialty, procedures, website, and search data.

Example:

For a foot/ankle surgeon:

* Do I need bunion surgery?
* How long is bunion surgery recovery?
* Can bunions be treated without surgery?
* When can I walk after surgery?

The system should then determine which questions the physician currently answers through their website, video, and social content.

---

# 5. YouTube Presence

Identify the physician's YouTube presence where possible and analyze:

* Educational videos
* Publishing activity
* Topics covered
* Physician-led videos
* Patient-question coverage
* Search visibility

---

# 6. Instagram Presence

Identify the physician's professional Instagram presence where reliably available.

We are interested in signals such as:

* Is there a professional account?
* Is the account active?
* Is the physician appearing in video?
* How much content is educational versus promotional?
* What medical topics are being discussed?
* Publishing consistency
* Patient-question/topic coverage

I do NOT want follower count to be the primary measurement.

The goal is to evaluate whether the physician is actually using Instagram to demonstrate expertise.

---

# 7. LinkedIn Presence

Identify the physician's professional LinkedIn presence where publicly and compliantly accessible.

Possible signals include:

* Profile presence
* Professional positioning
* Specialty/expertise consistency
* Recent thought-leadership/content presence
* Physician-authored educational content

I understand LinkedIn's official API/public-data access may be more restrictive than other platforms.

I want the developer to build this portion using compliant, maintainable methods and gracefully mark unavailable information as **unknown** rather than inventing or forcing data.

---

# 8. Competitor / Market Comparison

The system should identify approximately **5 relevant physicians** in the same specialty/market.

We want basic comparisons such as:

* Search visibility
* Review presence
* Website educational content
* YouTube/video presence
* Social/content activity

The first version does NOT need to perform an extremely expensive full analysis of every competitor.

---

# 9. Authority Scoring

I already have a scoring methodology.

The Authority Score will include areas such as:

* Search Authority
* Reputation Authority
* Educational Authority
* Video & Social Authority
* Website Authority

AI should NOT simply decide:

 "This physician deserves a score of 73."

AI will be used for structured tasks such as:

* Classifying website pages
* Identifying educational content
* Matching content with patient questions
* Classifying videos/social content
* Topic clustering
* Determining whether content is physician-led
* Identifying content gaps

The final Authority Score should be calculated using predefined scoring rules/formulas.

---

# Important Data Rule

The system must distinguish between:

### Confirmed Missing

Example:

We verified that the physician does not have a YouTube channel.

and:

### Unknown

Example:

The system could not confidently determine which YouTube channel belongs to the physician.

Unknown information should NOT automatically become a zero.

---

# API / Technology Accounts Already Available

I have already created accounts for:

* DataForSEO
* Firecrawl
* OpenAI API
* YouTube Data API
* Google Cloud
* PageSpeed Insights
* Supabase
* GitHub

I am open to recommendations for Instagram/LinkedIn data acquisition, but I do not want unnecessary expensive SaaS subscriptions added without a good reason.

---

# What I Need Built First

I need a simple internal interface.

### Input

Doctor Name:

Specialty:

City:

Website:

### RUN SCAN

The system then performs the research automatically.

---

# Example Output

## Dr. Example

### Physician Authority Score

**67 / 100**

### Search Authority

72

### Reputation Authority

81

### Educational Authority

49

### Video & Social Authority

38

### Website Authority

77

---

## Patient Education Coverage

**12 of 30 important patient questions answered**

18 opportunities identified.

---

## Video & Social Presence

YouTube:

14 educational videos identified

Instagram:

Active account; educational presence detected

LinkedIn:

Professional presence identified

---

## Market Comparison

Your Position:

**#4 of 6 physicians analyzed**

---

## Biggest Authority Opportunity

**Patient Education Video**

18 important patient questions currently have no meaningful physician-led video answer identified.

---

# Evidence

I also need an internal way to inspect the underlying data that produced the results.

For example:

* Search query
* Ranking
* Page URL
* Video URL
* Social profile
* Review data
* Source
* Classification
* Confidence

It does NOT need to be a beautiful interface initially.

Accuracy and reliability are more important.

---

# Preferred Technology

I am open to recommendations.

A possible stack could include:

* Python / FastAPI
* TypeScript / Next.js
* Supabase / PostgreSQL
* OpenAI API
* DataForSEO
* Firecrawl

I care more about clean architecture than a specific framework.

---

# Project Ownership

All code must be committed to a private GitHub repository owned by my company.

API accounts remain under my ownership.

API keys must never be hard-coded into the application or committed to GitHub.

---

# MVP Scope

This project is specifically for the **internal proof of concept**.

I do NOT currently need:

* Customer login system
* Billing
* Stripe
* Mobile app
* Complex admin dashboard
* CRM integration
* Automated email campaigns
* Advanced client dashboard
* Highly polished UI
* Enterprise-scale infrastructure

If the MVP works well, I intend to continue development into a polished public-facing product.

---

# Budget

**$1,000–$2,000 fixed price for the initial MVP**

I prefer milestone-based development.

There is potential for additional work if the prototype performs well.

---

# Developer Requirements

I am looking for someone strong in:

* API integration
* Python and/or TypeScript
* OpenAI API
* Structured AI outputs / JSON
* Supabase/PostgreSQL
* Data collection
* Web crawling
* API error handling
* Data normalization
* Scoring systems

SEO/search-data experience is a major plus.

Experience with Instagram or LinkedIn data integrations is also helpful.

Healthcare experience is NOT required.

---

# Please Answer These Questions

### 1.

Tell me about a project where you combined several APIs/data sources into one application.

### 2.

How would you build this so that one API failing does not cause the physician to incorrectly receive a zero?

### 3.

How would you structure the OpenAI portion so AI classifies the information but does not arbitrarily control the score?

### 4.

Have you worked with:

DataForSEO, Firecrawl, Supabase, OpenAI API, YouTube Data API, Instagram APIs/data, or LinkedIn APIs/data?

Please specify which.

### 5.

What would you recommend for reliably analyzing public Instagram and LinkedIn presence while remaining compliant with platform restrictions?

### 6.

What technology stack would you use for this MVP?

### 7.

Can you complete the work inside a GitHub repository that I own?

8.

Will you personally build the project, or will it be delegated?

9.

Please provide 1–3 examples of technically similar projects you have built.

 10.

Please begin your proposal with:

PHYSICIAN AUTHORITY

so I know you read the complete project description.



I have detailed technical specifications, scoring methodology, and data contracts available for the developer selected for the project.

title: Full-Stack/API Developer Needed — AI Physician Authority Scanner MVP
description:
# Full-Stack/API Developer Needed — AI Physician Authority Scanner MVP

## Project Overview

I own a video marketing company focused specifically on physicians, and I am building an internal tool called a **Physician Authority Scanner**.

The goal is simple:

I enter a physician's:

* Name
* Specialty
* City
* Website

The tool automatically analyzes the physician's digital presence across search, website content, video, social media, reviews, and competitors, then produces a structured **Physician Authority Score**.

I already have the scoring methodology, API accounts, data structure, and detailed product documentation.

I am NOT looking to build a polished SaaS application yet.

The first goal is to build a **working internal MVP/proof of concept** that I can test on approximately 5–20 physicians.

---

# What the Tool Needs to Analyze

## 1. Google Search Presence

Analyze relevant Google searches around the physician's:

* Specialty
* Procedures
* Conditions treated
* Location
* Name

We want to understand how visible the physician is when patients search for their expertise.

---

## 2. Google Maps & Reputation

Collect information such as:

* Maps/local presence
* Rating
* Review volume
* Review recency
* Relevant competitor comparisons

---

## 3. Physician Website

Crawl the physician's website and identify:

* Physician bio
* Conditions treated
* Procedures
* Patient education
* FAQs
* Blog/resources
* Relevant educational content

The system should determine how well the physician answers important patient questions online.

---

# 4. Patient Question Analysis

The system should create approximately **20–30 important patient questions** based on the physician's specialty, procedures, website, and search data.

Example:

For a foot/ankle surgeon:

* Do I need bunion surgery?
* How long is bunion surgery recovery?
* Can bunions be treated without surgery?
* When can I walk after surgery?

The system should then determine which questions the physician currently answers through their website, video, and social content.

---

# 5. YouTube Presence

Identify the physician's YouTube presence where possible and analyze:

* Educational videos
* Publishing activity
* Topics covered
* Physician-led videos
* Patient-question coverage
* Search visibility

---

# 6. Instagram Presence

Identify the physician's professional Instagram presence where reliably available.

We are interested in signals such as:

* Is there a professional account?
* Is the account active?
* Is the physician appearing in video?
* How much content is educational versus promotional?
* What medical topics are being discussed?
* Publishing consistency
* Patient-question/topic coverage

I do NOT want follower count to be the primary measurement.

The goal is to evaluate whether the physician is actually using Instagram to demonstrate expertise.

---

# 7. LinkedIn Presence

Identify the physician's professional LinkedIn presence where publicly and compliantly accessible.

Possible signals include:

* Profile presence
* Professional positioning
* Specialty/expertise consistency
* Recent thought-leadership/content presence
* Physician-authored educational content

I understand LinkedIn's official API/public-data access may be more restrictive than other platforms.

I want the developer to build this portion using compliant, maintainable methods and gracefully mark unavailable information as **unknown** rather than inventing or forcing data.

---

# 8. Competitor / Market Comparison

The system should identify approximately **5 relevant physicians** in the same specialty/market.

We want basic comparisons such as:

* Search visibility
* Review presence
* Website educational content
* YouTube/video presence
* Social/content activity

The first version does NOT need to perform an extremely expensive full analysis of every competitor.

---

# 9. Authority Scoring

I already have a scoring methodology.

The Authority Score will include areas such as:

* Search Authority
* Reputation Authority
* Educational Authority
* Video & Social Authority
* Website Authority

AI should NOT simply decide:

 "This physician deserves a score of 73."

AI will be used for structured tasks such as:

* Classifying website pages
* Identifying educational content
* Matching content with patient questions
* Classifying videos/social content
* Topic clustering
* Determining whether content is physician-led
* Identifying content gaps

The final Authority Score should be calculated using predefined scoring rules/formulas.

---

# Important Data Rule

The system must distinguish between:

### Confirmed Missing

Example:

We verified that the physician does not have a YouTube channel.

and:

### Unknown

Example:

The system could not confidently determine which YouTube channel belongs to the physician.

Unknown information should NOT automatically become a zero.

---

# API / Technology Accounts Already Available

I have already created accounts for:

* DataForSEO
* Firecrawl
* OpenAI API
* YouTube Data API
* Google Cloud
* PageSpeed Insights
* Supabase
* GitHub

I am open to recommendations for Instagram/LinkedIn data acquisition, but I do not want unnecessary expensive SaaS subscriptions added without a good reason.

---

# What I Need Built First

I need a simple internal interface.

### Input

Doctor Name:

Specialty:

City:

Website:

### RUN SCAN

The system then performs the research automatically.

---

# Example Output

## Dr. Example

### Physician Authority Score

**67 / 100**

### Search Authority

72

### Reputation Authority

81

### Educational Authority

49

### Video & Social Authority

38

### Website Authority

77

---

## Patient Education Coverage

**12 of 30 important patient questions answered**

18 opportunities identified.

---

## Video & Social Presence

YouTube:

14 educational videos identified

Instagram:

Active account; educational presence detected

LinkedIn:

Professional presence identified

---

## Market Comparison

Your Position:

**#4 of 6 physicians analyzed**

---

## Biggest Authority Opportunity

**Patient Education Video**

18 important patient questions currently have no meaningful physician-led video answer identified.

---

# Evidence

I also need an internal way to inspect the underlying data that produced the results.

For example:

* Search query
* Ranking
* Page URL
* Video URL
* Social profile
* Review data
* Source
* Classification
* Confidence

It does NOT need to be a beautiful interface initially.

Accuracy and reliability are more important.

---

# Preferred Technology

I am open to recommendations.

A possible stack could include:

* Python / FastAPI
* TypeScript / Next.js
* Supabase / PostgreSQL
* OpenAI API
* DataForSEO
* Firecrawl

I care more about clean architecture than a specific framework.

---

# Project Ownership

All code must be committed to a private GitHub repository owned by my company.

API accounts remain under my ownership.

API keys must never be hard-coded into the application or committed to GitHub.

---

# MVP Scope

This project is specifically for the **internal proof of concept**.

I do NOT currently need:

* Customer login system
* Billing
* Stripe
* Mobile app
* Complex admin dashboard
* CRM integration
* Automated email campaigns
* Advanced client dashboard
* Highly polished UI
* Enterprise-scale infrastructure

If the MVP works well, I intend to continue development into a polished public-facing product.

---

# Budget

**$1,000–$2,000 fixed price for the initial MVP**

I prefer milestone-based development.

There is potential for additional work if the prototype performs well.

---

# Developer Requirements

I am looking for someone strong in:

* API integration
* Python and/or TypeScript
* OpenAI API
* Structured AI outputs / JSON
* Supabase/PostgreSQL
* Data collection
* Web crawling
* API error handling
* Data normalization
* Scoring systems

SEO/search-data experience is a major plus.

Experience with Instagram or LinkedIn data integrations is also helpful.

Healthcare experience is NOT required.

---

# Please Answer These Questions

### 1.

Tell me about a project where you combined several APIs/data sources into one application.

### 2.

How would you build this so that one API failing does not cause the physician to incorrectly receive a zero?

### 3.

How would you structure the OpenAI portion so AI classifies the information but does not arbitrarily control the score?

### 4.

Have you worked with:

DataForSEO, Firecrawl, Supabase, OpenAI API, YouTube Data API, Instagram APIs/data, or LinkedIn APIs/data?

Please specify which.

### 5.

What would you recommend for reliably analyzing public Instagram and LinkedIn presence while remaining compliant with platform restrictions?

### 6.

What technology stack would you use for this MVP?

### 7.

Can you complete the work inside a GitHub repository that I own?

8.

Will you personally build the project, or will it be delegated?

9.

Please provide 1–3 examples of technically similar projects you have built.

 10.

Please begin your proposal with:

PHYSICIAN AUTHORITY

so I know you read the complete project description.



I have detailed technical specifications, scoring methodology, and data contracts available for the developer selected for the project.

title: WordPress Developer for Luxury 7-Page Site (Gravity Forms/S3/WP Job Manager)
description:

· WordPress on LiteSpeed, PHP/MySQL, Cloudflare CDN/SSL/DNS, Gravity Forms Pro, WP Job Manager, AWS S3 (eu-west-2), Google Workspace SMTP.
· Install a selected ThemeForest luxury theme and apply custom styling: typography, spacing, gold/slate colour palette, responsive breakpoints.

Scope of Work – 7 Pages

1. Home Page (/)
   Hero section, trust credentials, 3 Service Pillar Cards (Childcare & Education; Private Household Management; Family Office & Lifestyle), dual CTAs ("I'm Looking to Hire" / "I'm a Professional"), Private Client Edit module with honeypot and GDPR consent.
2. About Us & The Placement Journey (/about-us)
   Founder narrative, 15-year Royal Household / Sovereign pedigree, 6-step hiring lifecycle roadmap.

   "Verbatim Verification" vetting methodology, sovereign-grade screening breakdown (DBS, identity, references, NDAs, discretion).

   Dedicated sections for the 3 pillars with all sub-roles, each with CTAs to /contact.
5. Active Mandates Portal (/vacancies)
   WP Job Manager job board with filters (keyword, location, category, live-in/live-out, salary tier). Single mandate template with Quick Apply.
6. Private Talent Intake Portal (/register)
   Candidate registration standards and 3-step, 22-field Gravity Forms intake.
7. Client Registration & Contact (/contact)
   Confidential intake for Principals/Family Offices/Chiefs of Staff, 10-field consultation form, general contact module, Mayfair office details, appointment-only notice.

---

Form Automation & Data Ingestion (Gravity Forms Pro)

All forms must include validation, conditional logic, spam protection, and instant email notifications to Google Workspace.

· Candidate Intake Engine (22 fields, 3 steps): identity, right to work, pillar/role selection, UHNW experience, languages, certifications, salary/daily rate, living preference, CV upload, GDPR consent, digital signature, timestamp.
· Client Consultation Form (10 fields): principal name, entity, email, phone, location, pillar/role, placement type, timeline, notes, confidentiality acknowledgement.
· Private Client Edit Capture (3 fields): name, email, client type, GDPR consent.
· General Inquiries (5 fields): name, email, phone, subject, message, honeypot.

---

Document Security & AWS S3 Pipeline

· All uploaded CVs/certificates route directly to a private AWS S3 bucket in London (eu-west-2).
· Zero local retention in WordPress media library or /wp-content/uploads/.
· Bucket must have Public Access Blocked and SSE-S3/AES-256 encryption.
· Admin notification links must use short-lived pre-signed URLs.

---

Active Mandates System (WP Job Manager)

· WP Job Manager styled to match the luxury palette.
· AJAX live search and multi-parameter filtering.
· Single vacancy page with Quick Apply redirect to /register with Job Reference ID pre-populated.

---

Acceptance Criteria

· Visual polish matches the benchmark site and approved luxury theme demo.
· Fully responsive on desktop, tablet, iOS Safari, Android Chrome — no overlapping or horizontal breaks.
· 100% verified form submissions, conditional branching, email delivery, secure S3 ingestion.
· SSL enforced, LiteSpeed caching enabled, spam protection verified, UK GDPR cookie banner active.

---

Milestone Structure

Your proposal must include a quote broken into these 4 fixed-price milestones:

· M1: Environment setup, branding, core informational pages (Home, About Us, Benchmark).
· M2: Gravity Forms engine, AWS S3 secure pipeline, Google Workspace notification routing.
· M3: WP Job Manager board with filters and Quick Apply; remaining 4 pages.
· M4: Infrastructure hardening, QA, launch and 14-day post-launch warranty (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, daily backups to S3, Cloudflare Turnstile, LiteSpeed/WebP optimisation, OpenGraph meta tags, cross-browser/mobile QA).

---

How to Apply

Your proposal must include:

1. Total fixed price in USD
2. Price per milestone (M1–M4)
3. 2–3 live URLs you personally built using Gravity Forms, AWS S3, and WP Job Manager (or closest equivalent)
4. Available start date and estimated completion date
5. Confirmation: "I have reviewed the benchmark site and the scope above, and I confirm I can deliver this personally."

Proposals missing any of the above will be declined.

This job is for a single freelancer only. No agencies, no outsourcing. All work must be performed by the named freelancer. All IP transfers to Belgravia & Co upon final payment.

---

Screening Questions to Add in Upwork:

1. Are you an individual freelancer, not an agency? Confirm you will personally perform all work and will not subcontract any part.
2. What is your total fixed price in USD for the full 7-page build with 4 milestones?
3. What is your price per milestone — M1, M2, M3, M4?
4. List 2–3 live URLs you personally built using Gravity Forms, AWS S3, and WP Job Manager, or closest equivalent.
5. What is your available start date and estimated completion date?

---

Extra tips to avoid time-wasters:

· Set the job to Private / Invite-only if you want maximum control, then invite 5–10 developers manually.
· Do a 10-minute video call before hiring. Ask them to screen-share the admin of a past Gravity Forms + S3 build.
· Stay on Upwork. If they ask to move to WhatsApp or Telegram before the contract starts, decline.
· Fund one milestone at a time. Release escrow only after you have tested and approved that milestone.

title: Web Developer Needed to Build a Secure Healthcare CRM
description:
We are looking for an experienced developer to take on custom **CRM development** for our healthcare company. The off-the-shelf software we've tried doesn't fit our specific patient workflows, so we need a system built from scratch that actually works for our team.

Since we are dealing with sensitive patient information, security is our absolute top priority. The application must be 100% **HIPAA** compliant. We need someone who knows how to build secure access controls, audit logs, and keep patient data fully protected.

Here is what we are looking for technically:
*   **Web development:** A clean, easy-to-use web application that our staff can access directly from their browsers.
*   **PostgreSQL:** A robust, reliable database to store all of our patient and scheduling data securely. 
*   **Docker:** The application must be packaged using **Docker** so it's easy to deploy, update, and scale on our servers without breaking things.

**To weed out automated responses and make sure we are a good fit, please answer these two business questions in your proposal:**

1. **Role-Based Access:** In our clinic, our front desk staff and our medical practitioners will both use this CRM. However, practitioners need to see sensitive patient notes, while the front desk only needs to see contact info and appointment times. How would you structure the database and application to handle this securely without making the app clunky?
2. **Zero-Downtime Updates:** We operate during normal clinic hours and can't afford the CRM to go down when we push an update or add a new feature. How will your Docker setup handle deploying new updates without interrupting our staff's workday?

If you have experience building secure web apps—especially in the medical space—please apply, share your past work, and let me know how you'd approach this project!

title: Build a demo app that uses SenseLab (agent memory API) + write a technical walkthrough
description:
SenseLab is a memory and coordination layer for AI agents — a versioned, provider-agnostic API (MCP-based) that lets agents remember, share context, and coordinate across sessions. We're backed by a16z's Speedrun program.

**About this initiative:**
We're launching a Creator Initiative: we're commissioning developers to build real projects on SenseLab and share what they made. The goal is to showcase the range of use cases developers can build on top of an agent memory layer — multi-agent coordination, shared memory spaces, persistent context, agent-to-agent handoffs, and more. We want to see (and help others see) what's possible.

**What you'll do:**
- Build a small but real project using the SenseLab API — pick a use case that interests you (e.g. a multi-agent app using shared memory, an integration with an existing agent framework, a persistent-memory assistant, a coordination workflow).
- Publish the code to a public GitHub repo.
- Write a clear technical walkthrough (blog post or LinkedIn) explaining what you built and how you used SenseLab

**What we're looking for:**
- Hands-on experience building with LLM agents (LangGraph, CrewAI, MCP, or similar).
- Ability to write clearly for a developer audience — the write-up matters as much as the code.
- Curiosity about agent memory/coordination and ideas about what you'd build.

**To apply:** Tell us (1) your agent-building experience with a link to something you've made, and (2) one use case you'd be excited to build on SenseLab.

title: Web Developer Needed to Build a Secure Healthcare CRM
description:
We are looking for an experienced developer to take on custom **CRM development** for our healthcare company. The off-the-shelf software we've tried doesn't fit our specific patient workflows, so we need a system built from scratch that actually works for our team.

Since we are dealing with sensitive patient information, security is our absolute top priority. The application must be 100% **HIPAA** compliant. We need someone who knows how to build secure access controls, audit logs, and keep patient data fully protected.

Here is what we are looking for technically:
*   **Web development:** A clean, easy-to-use web application that our staff can access directly from their browsers.
*   **PostgreSQL:** A robust, reliable database to store all of our patient and scheduling data securely. 
*   **Docker:** The application must be packaged using **Docker** so it's easy to deploy, update, and scale on our servers without breaking things.

**To weed out automated responses and make sure we are a good fit, please answer these two business questions in your proposal:**

1. **Role-Based Access:** In our clinic, our front desk staff and our medical practitioners will both use this CRM. However, practitioners need to see sensitive patient notes, while the front desk only needs to see contact info and appointment times. How would you structure the database and application to handle this securely without making the app clunky?
2. **Zero-Downtime Updates:** We operate during normal clinic hours and can't afford the CRM to go down when we push an update or add a new feature. How will your Docker setup handle deploying new updates without interrupting our staff's workday?

If you have experience building secure web apps—especially in the medical space—please apply, share your past work, and let me know how you'd approach this project!

description:
We are looking for an experienced developer to take on custom **CRM development** for our healthcare company. The off-the-shelf software we've tried doesn't fit our specific patient workflows, so we need a system built from scratch that actually works for our team.

Since we are dealing with sensitive patient information, security is our absolute top priority. The application must be 100% **HIPAA** compliant. We need someone who knows how to build secure access controls, audit logs, and keep patient data fully protected.

title: Web Developer Needed to Build a Secure Healthcare CRM
description:
We are looking for an experienced developer to take on custom **CRM development** for our healthcare company. The off-the-shelf software we've tried doesn't fit our specific patient workflows, so we need a system built from scratch that actually works for our team.

Since we are dealing with sensitive patient information, security is our absolute top priority. The application must be 100% **HIPAA** compliant. We need someone who knows how to build secure access controls, audit logs, and keep patient data fully protected.

Here is what we are looking for technically:
*   **Web development:** A clean, easy-to-use web application that our staff can access directly from their browsers.
*   **PostgreSQL:** A robust, reliable database to store all of our patient and scheduling data securely. 
*   **Docker:** The application must be packaged using **Docker** so it's easy to deploy, update, and scale on our servers without breaking things.

**To weed out automated responses and make sure we are a good fit, please answer these two business questions in your proposal:**

1. **Role-Based Access:** In our clinic, our front desk staff and our medical practitioners will both use this CRM. However, practitioners need to see sensitive patient notes, while the front desk only needs to see contact info and appointment times. How would you structure the database and application to handle this securely without making the app clunky?
2. **Zero-Downtime Updates:** We operate during normal clinic hours and can't afford the CRM to go down when we push an update or add a new feature. How will your Docker setup handle deploying new updates without interrupting our staff's workday?

If you have experience building secure web apps—especially in the medical space—please apply, share your past work, and let me know how you'd approach this project!

title: Landbot Developer Needed: Countdown Timer, Video Recording & Assessment Report
description:

We currently have a BCG-style online case assessment simulation built and hosted on Landbot. The assessment is already fully functional, but we are looking for an experienced Landbot developer to implement several new features.

Scope of work

1. Assessment countdown timer

We currently track how long candidates take and show their completion time at the end.

We now want to:

- Display a visible countdown timer throughout the assessment
- Have the timer persist across the full Landbot flow
- When the timer reaches zero, show a pop-up/message telling the candidate that their time has expired
- Allow the candidate to continue and finish the assessment even after time expires
- Ensure the timer remains accurate as the candidate moves between questions/blocks

2. Video case conclusion

At the end of the assessment, candidates should complete a short case conclusion exercise:

- 1 minute to prepare their conclusion, with a countdown timer
- 1 minute to record and deliver their conclusion on video
- The candidate's response should be recorded within, or seamlessly connected to, the assessment experience
- The recorded response should be converted into a text transcript
- The candidate should then be able to compare their transcript with our model case conclusion

We are open to recommendations on the best technical solution for the video recording and speech-to-text functionality.

3. End-of-assessment performance report

We would also like to generate a personalised report for the candidate after completing the assessment.

The report should ideally include:

- Overall score
- Assessment completion time
- Question-by-question breakdown
- Candidate's answer for each question
- Our recommended answer
- Explanation for each answer
- Transcript of the candidate's final case conclusion

We are open to recommendations on whether the report should be displayed directly within Landbot, generated as a separate web page/PDF, or handled through another solution.

title: Web Developer Needed to Build a Secure Healthcare CRM
description:
We are looking for an experienced developer to take on custom **CRM development** for our healthcare company. The off-the-shelf software we've tried doesn't fit our specific patient workflows, so we need a system built from scratch that actually works for our team.

Since we are dealing with sensitive patient information, security is our absolute top priority. The application must be 100% **HIPAA** compliant. We need someone who knows how to build secure access controls, audit logs, and keep patient data fully protected.

Here is what we are looking for technically:
*   **Web development:** A clean, easy-to-use web application that our staff can access directly from their browsers.
*   **PostgreSQL:** A robust, reliable database to store all of our patient and scheduling data securely. 
*   **Docker:** The application must be packaged using **Docker** so it's easy to deploy, update, and scale on our servers without breaking things.

**To weed out automated responses and make sure we are a good fit, please answer these two business questions in your proposal:**

1. **Role-Based Access:** In our clinic, our front desk staff and our medical practitioners will both use this CRM. However, practitioners need to see sensitive patient notes, while the front desk only needs to see contact info and appointment times. How would you structure the database and application to handle this securely without making the app clunky?
2. **Zero-Downtime Updates:** We operate during normal clinic hours and can't afford the CRM to go down when we push an update or add a new feature. How will your Docker setup handle deploying new updates without interrupting our staff's workday?

If you have experience building secure web apps—especially in the medical space—please apply, share your past work, and let me know how you'd approach this project!

title: Landbot Developer Needed: Countdown Timer, Video Recording & Assessment Report
description:

We currently have a BCG-style online case assessment simulation built and hosted on Landbot. The assessment is already fully functional, but we are looking for an experienced Landbot developer to implement several new features.

Scope of work

1. Assessment countdown timer

We currently track how long candidates take and show their completion time at the end.

We now want to:

- Display a visible countdown timer throughout the assessment
- Have the timer persist across the full Landbot flow
- When the timer reaches zero, show a pop-up/message telling the candidate that their time has expired
- Allow the candidate to continue and finish the assessment even after time expires
- Ensure the timer remains accurate as the candidate moves between questions/blocks

- 1 minute to prepare their conclusion, with a countdown timer
- 1 minute to record and deliver their conclusion on video
- The candidate's response should be recorded within, or seamlessly connected to, the assessment experience
- The recorded response should be converted into a text transcript
- The candidate should then be able to compare their transcript with our model case conclusion

We are open to recommendations on the best technical solution for the video recording and speech-to-text functionality.

3. End-of-assessment performance report

We would also like to generate a personalised report for the candidate after completing the assessment.

The report should ideally include:

- Overall score
- Assessment completion time
- Question-by-question breakdown
- Candidate's answer for each question
- Our recommended answer
- Explanation for each answer
- Transcript of the candidate's final case conclusion

We are open to recommendations on whether the report should be displayed directly within Landbot, generated as a separate web page/PDF, or handled through another solution.

- Landbot

title: Web Developer Needed to Build a Secure Healthcare CRM
description:
We are looking for an experienced developer to take on custom **CRM development** for our healthcare company. The off-the-shelf software we've tried doesn't fit our specific patient workflows, so we need a system built from scratch that actually works for our team.

Since we are dealing with sensitive patient information, security is our absolute top priority. The application must be 100% **HIPAA** compliant. We need someone who knows how to build secure access controls, audit logs, and keep patient data fully protected.

Here is what we are looking for technically:
*   **Web development:** A clean, easy-to-use web application that our staff can access directly from their browsers.
*   **PostgreSQL:** A robust, reliable database to store all of our patient and scheduling data securely. 
*   **Docker:** The application must be packaged using **Docker** so it's easy to deploy, update, and scale on our servers without breaking things.

**To weed out automated responses and make sure we are a good fit, please answer these two business questions in your proposal:**

1. **Role-Based Access:** In our clinic, our front desk staff and our medical practitioners will both use this CRM. However, practitioners need to see sensitive patient notes, while the front desk only needs to see contact info and appointment times. How would you structure the database and application to handle this securely without making the app clunky?
2. **Zero-Downtime Updates:** We operate during normal clinic hours and can't afford the CRM to go down when we push an update or add a new feature. How will your Docker setup handle deploying new updates without interrupting our staff's workday?

If you have experience building secure web apps—especially in the medical space—please apply, share your past work, and let me know how you'd approach this project!

title: Landbot Developer Needed: Countdown Timer, Video Recording & Assessment Report

Scope of work

1. Assessment countdown timer

We currently track how long candidates take and show their completion time at the end.

We now want to:

- Display a visible countdown timer throughout the assessment
- Have the timer persist across the full Landbot flow
- When the timer reaches zero, show a pop-up/message telling the candidate that their time has expired
- Allow the candidate to continue and finish the assessment even after time expires
- Ensure the timer remains accurate as the candidate moves between questions/blocks

2. Video case conclusion

At the end of the assessment, candidates should complete a short case conclusion exercise:

- 1 minute to prepare their conclusion, with a countdown timer
- 1 minute to record and deliver their conclusion on video
- The candidate's response should be recorded within, or seamlessly connected to, the assessment experience
- The recorded response should be converted into a text transcript
- The candidate should then be able to compare their transcript with our model case conclusion

We are open to recommendations on the best technical solution for the video recording and speech-to-text functionality.

3. End-of-assessment performance report

We would also like to generate a personalised report for the candidate after completing the assessment.

The report should ideally include:

- Overall score
- Assessment completion time
- Question-by-question breakdown
- Candidate's answer for each question
- Our recommended answer
- Explanation for each answer
- Transcript of the candidate's final case conclusion
- Our model case conclusion

We are open to recommendations on whether the report should be displayed directly within Landbot, generated as a separate web page/PDF, or handled through another solution.

What we're looking for

You should have strong experience with:

- Landbot

- Landbot Webhooks/APIs

- Video/audio recording integrations

title: Senior AI Engineer - Build an Agentic AI & RAG Enterprise Platform
description:
We are building a long-term, enterprise-grade AI platform designed to help European businesses securely connect their private data, deploy intelligent AI agents, automate business workflows, and gain better control over how AI is used across their organization.

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior AI Engineer / AI Architect to join us for a long-term collaboration and help architect, build, and continuously improve this platform.

This is not a simple chatbot or one-off AI integration. We are looking for someone who can think at the system-architecture level and help us build a production-ready AI product from the ground up.

PROJECT VISION

The platform will combine Agentic AI, RAG, LLMs, enterprise data integration, workflow automation, AI evaluation, observability, and security into one scalable system.

The long-term goal is to allow organizations to:

• Connect internal documents, databases, APIs, CRM/ERP systems, and knowledge sources
• Build secure AI knowledge bases
• Deploy specialized AI agents for different business functions
• Automate multi-step business processes
• Search and reason over large internal knowledge bases
• Generate reports, analysis, summaries, and recommendations
• Allow AI agents to interact with approved business systems
• Maintain human approval for sensitive actions
• Monitor AI quality, cost, latency, and reliability
• Maintain detailed audit trails of AI activity
• Support multiple organizations and users through a scalable architecture

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

You will be involved in:

• Designing the overall AI/ML architecture
• Building production-grade RAG pipelines
• Developing multi-agent and agentic AI workflows
• Designing agent memory and context-management systems
• Working with LLMs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and other relevant models
• Building intelligent document-processing pipelines
• Implementing vector search and hybrid search
• Working with embeddings, reranking and retrieval optimization
• Developing AI-powered workflow automation
• Integrating external APIs, SaaS platforms, CRM and ERP systems
• Building evaluation frameworks for LLM and RAG performance
• Implementing AI observability and tracing
• Reducing hallucinations and improving response reliability
• Designing permission-aware enterprise knowledge retrieval
• Building human-in-the-loop approval mechanisms
• Designing scalable backend services and APIs
• Working with cloud infrastructure and production deployments
• Contributing to security, privacy and AI governance architecture
• Continuously researching and implementing new AI capabilities

TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT

We expect strong experience with several of the following:

• Python
• FastAPI
• LLM APIs
• OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini
• LangChain
• LangGraph
• RAG
• Agentic AI
• Multi-agent systems
• Function/tool calling
• Embeddings
• Vector databases
• PostgreSQL
• pgvector
• Redis
• REST APIs
• Webhooks
• Docker
• Kubernetes
• AWS / GCP / Azure
• CI/CD
• Git
• AI evaluation frameworks
• LLM observability
• Prompt engineering
• Structured outputs
• Document intelligence
• OCR
• Data pipelines

Experience with platforms such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, OpenSearch, Supabase, Langfuse or similar technologies is a strong advantage.

ENTERPRISE & EUROPEAN REQUIREMENTS

Because the platform is intended for enterprise customers, experience with secure and responsible AI systems is extremely valuable.

We are particularly interested in candidates who understand:

• GDPR-conscious architecture
• Data privacy
• Encryption and secure data handling
• Role-based access control
• Tenant isolation
• Audit logging
• AI governance
• Model evaluation
• Explainability
• Human oversight
• Secure API architecture
• Enterprise authentication and authorization

You do not need to be a legal expert, but you should understand how privacy, security and AI governance influence technical architecture.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for someone who can do much more than execute predefined tickets.

The ideal engineer should be able to:

• Understand a business problem and translate it into an AI architecture
• Make sound technical decisions independently
• Build prototypes and convert successful prototypes into production systems
• Evaluate different models and technologies objectively
• Design systems for reliability and scalability
• Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code
• Think about security from the beginning
• Understand the limitations of current LLM technology
• Challenge technical assumptions when necessary
• Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Take ownership of major components of the platform

LONG-TERM COLLABORATION

This is intended to be a long-term engagement.

The initial phase will focus on architecture, technical validation and development of the core AI infrastructure.

Future phases may include:

• Additional AI agents
• Advanced RAG capabilities
• Enterprise integrations
• Workflow automation
• Multi-tenant architecture
• AI analytics and observability
• Mobile/web product integrations
• Additional language support
• Enterprise security improvements
• AI governance features
• Performance optimization
• Continuous model and infrastructure improvements

We are looking for someone who wants to become a key technical contributor rather than someone interested in completing a short one-off project.

IMPORTANT

Please do not apply if your experience is primarily limited to basic chatbot development, prompt writing, or connecting a single LLM API to a simple application.

We are specifically looking for someone with real experience designing and building production AI systems.

WHEN APPLYING, PLEASE INCLUDE:

1. A brief overview of your experience building production AI systems.
2. Examples of Agentic AI or RAG systems you have personally developed.
3. Your preferred architecture for a scalable enterprise RAG + Agentic AI platform.
4. Which LLMs, vector databases and agent frameworks you have worked with.
5. One difficult AI engineering problem you solved and how you approached it.
6. Links to relevant GitHub repositories, demos, case studies or production projects, where available.
7. Your availability and expected long-term weekly commitment.

We are prepared to invest in the right technical person and are more interested in engineering depth, architecture skills and long-term capability than simply choosing the lowest hourly rate.

If you are excited about building serious, production-grade AI infrastructure rather than another basic chatbot, we would like to hear from you.

title: Web Developer Needed to Build a Secure Healthcare CRM
description:
We are looking for an experienced developer to take on custom **CRM development** for our healthcare company. The off-the-shelf software we've tried doesn't fit our specific patient workflows, so we need a system built from scratch that actually works for our team.

Since we are dealing with sensitive patient information, security is our absolute top priority. The application must be 100% **HIPAA** compliant. We need someone who knows how to build secure access controls, audit logs, and keep patient data fully protected.

Here is what we are looking for technically:
*   **Web development:** A clean, easy-to-use web application that our staff can access directly from their browsers.
*   **PostgreSQL:** A robust, reliable database to store all of our patient and scheduling data securely. 
*   **Docker:** The application must be packaged using **Docker** so it's easy to deploy, update, and scale on our servers without breaking things.

**To weed out automated responses and make sure we are a good fit, please answer these two business questions in your proposal:**

1. **Role-Based Access:** In our clinic, our front desk staff and our medical practitioners will both use this CRM. However, practitioners need to see sensitive patient notes, while the front desk only needs to see contact info and appointment times. How would you structure the database and application to handle this securely without making the app clunky?
2. **Zero-Downtime Updates:** We operate during normal clinic hours and can't afford the CRM to go down when we push an update or add a new feature. How will your Docker setup handle deploying new updates without interrupting our staff's workday?

If you have experience building secure web apps—especially in the medical space—please apply, share your past work, and let me know how you'd approach this project!

We are looking for someone who can confidently communicate with clients, effectively lead developers, and take ownership of projects from initial requirements through successful delivery. If you have AI development experience as well, that is a significant advantage.

title: Landbot Developer Needed: Countdown Timer, Video Recording & Assessment Report
description:
Landbot Developer Needed: Countdown Timer, Video Recording & Assessment Report

We currently have a BCG-style online case assessment simulation built and hosted on Landbot. The assessment is already fully functional, but we are looking for an experienced Landbot developer to implement several new features.

Scope of work

1. Assessment countdown timer

We currently track how long candidates take and show their completion time at the end.

We now want to:

- Display a visible countdown timer throughout the assessment
- Have the timer persist across the full Landbot flow
- When the timer reaches zero, show a pop-up/message telling the candidate that their time has expired
- Allow the candidate to continue and finish the assessment even after time expires
- Ensure the timer remains accurate as the candidate moves between questions/blocks

2. Video case conclusion

At the end of the assessment, candidates should complete a short case conclusion exercise:

- 1 minute to prepare their conclusion, with a countdown timer
- 1 minute to record and deliver their conclusion on video
- The candidate's response should be recorded within, or seamlessly connected to, the assessment experience
- The recorded response should be converted into a text transcript
- The candidate should then be able to compare their transcript with our model case conclusion

We are open to recommendations on the best technical solution for the video recording and speech-to-text functionality.

3. End-of-assessment performance report

We would also like to generate a personalised report for the candidate after completing the assessment.

The report should ideally include:

- Overall score
- Assessment completion time
- Question-by-question breakdown
- Candidate's answer for each question
- Our recommended answer
- Explanation for each answer
- Transcript of the candidate's final case conclusion
- Our model case conclusion

We are open to recommendations on whether the report should be displayed directly within Landbot, generated as a separate web page/PDF, or handled through another solution.

What we're looking for

You should have strong experience with:

- Landbot
- Custom JavaScript within Landbot
- Landbot Webhooks/APIs
- Third-party API integrations
- Video/audio recording integrations
- Speech-to-text solutions
- Building custom reporting/results experiences

This is not a basic Landbot flow-building project. We are specifically looking for someone comfortable implementing custom functionality and integrations.
