title: Senior AI Engineer - Build an Agentic AI & RAG Enterprise Platform
description:
We are building a long-term, enterprise-grade AI platform designed to help European businesses securely connect their private data, deploy intelligent AI agents, automate business workflows, and gain better control over how AI is used across their organization.

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior AI Engineer / AI Architect to join us for a long-term collaboration and help architect, build, and continuously improve this platform.

This is not a simple chatbot or one-off AI integration. We are looking for someone who can think at the system-architecture level and help us build a production-ready AI product from the ground up.

PROJECT VISION

The platform will combine Agentic AI, RAG, LLMs, enterprise data integration, workflow automation, AI evaluation, observability, and security into one scalable system.

The long-term goal is to allow organizations to:

• Connect internal documents, databases, APIs, CRM/ERP systems, and knowledge sources
• Build secure AI knowledge bases
• Deploy specialized AI agents for different business functions
• Automate multi-step business processes
• Search and reason over large internal knowledge bases
• Generate reports, analysis, summaries, and recommendations
• Allow AI agents to interact with approved business systems
• Maintain human approval for sensitive actions
• Monitor AI quality, cost, latency, and reliability
• Maintain detailed audit trails of AI activity
• Support multiple organizations and users through a scalable architecture

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

You will be involved in:

• Designing the overall AI/ML architecture
• Building production-grade RAG pipelines
• Developing multi-agent and agentic AI workflows
• Designing agent memory and context-management systems
• Working with LLMs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and other relevant models
• Building intelligent document-processing pipelines
• Implementing vector search and hybrid search
• Working with embeddings, reranking and retrieval optimization
• Developing AI-powered workflow automation
• Integrating external APIs, SaaS platforms, CRM and ERP systems
• Building evaluation frameworks for LLM and RAG performance
• Implementing AI observability and tracing
• Reducing hallucinations and improving response reliability
• Designing permission-aware enterprise knowledge retrieval
• Building human-in-the-loop approval mechanisms
• Designing scalable backend services and APIs
• Working with cloud infrastructure and production deployments
• Contributing to security, privacy and AI governance architecture
• Continuously researching and implementing new AI capabilities

TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT

We expect strong experience with several of the following:

• Python
• FastAPI
• LLM APIs
• OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini
• LangChain
• LangGraph
• RAG
• Agentic AI
• Multi-agent systems
• Function/tool calling
• Embeddings
• Vector databases
• PostgreSQL
• pgvector
• Redis
• REST APIs
• Webhooks
• Docker
• Kubernetes
• AWS / GCP / Azure
• CI/CD
• Git
• AI evaluation frameworks
• LLM observability
• Prompt engineering
• Structured outputs
• Document intelligence
• OCR
• Data pipelines

Experience with platforms such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, OpenSearch, Supabase, Langfuse or similar technologies is a strong advantage.

ENTERPRISE & EUROPEAN REQUIREMENTS

Because the platform is intended for enterprise customers, experience with secure and responsible AI systems is extremely valuable.

We are particularly interested in candidates who understand:

• GDPR-conscious architecture
• Data privacy
• Encryption and secure data handling
• Role-based access control
• Tenant isolation
• Audit logging
• AI governance
• Model evaluation
• Explainability
• Human oversight
• Secure API architecture
• Enterprise authentication and authorization

You do not need to be a legal expert, but you should understand how privacy, security and AI governance influence technical architecture.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for someone who can do much more than execute predefined tickets.

The ideal engineer should be able to:

• Understand a business problem and translate it into an AI architecture
• Make sound technical decisions independently
• Build prototypes and convert successful prototypes into production systems
• Evaluate different models and technologies objectively
• Design systems for reliability and scalability
• Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code
• Think about security from the beginning
• Understand the limitations of current LLM technology
• Challenge technical assumptions when necessary
• Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Take ownership of major components of the platform

LONG-TERM COLLABORATION

This is intended to be a long-term engagement.

The initial phase will focus on architecture, technical validation and development of the core AI infrastructure.

Future phases may include:

• Additional AI agents
• Advanced RAG capabilities
• Enterprise integrations
• Workflow automation
• Multi-tenant architecture
• AI analytics and observability
• Mobile/web product integrations

• Enterprise security improvements

We are looking for someone who wants to become a key technical contributor rather than someone interested in completing a short one-off project.

IMPORTANT

Please do not apply if your experience is primarily limited to basic chatbot development, prompt writing, or connecting a single LLM API to a simple application.

We are specifically looking for someone with real experience designing and building production AI systems.

WHEN APPLYING, PLEASE INCLUDE:

title: Web Developer Needed to Build a Secure Healthcare CRM
description:
We are looking for an experienced developer to take on custom **CRM development** for our healthcare company. The off-the-shelf software we've tried doesn't fit our specific patient workflows, so we need a system built from scratch that actually works for our team.

Since we are dealing with sensitive patient information, security is our absolute top priority. The application must be 100% **HIPAA** compliant. We need someone who knows how to build secure access controls, audit logs, and keep patient data fully protected.

Here is what we are looking for technically:
*   **Web development:** A clean, easy-to-use web application that our staff can access directly from their browsers.
*   **PostgreSQL:** A robust, reliable database to store all of our patient and scheduling data securely. 
*   **Docker:** The application must be packaged using **Docker** so it's easy to deploy, update, and scale on our servers without breaking things.

**To weed out automated responses and make sure we are a good fit, please answer these two business questions in your proposal:**

1. **Role-Based Access:** In our clinic, our front desk staff and our medical practitioners will both use this CRM. However, practitioners need to see sensitive patient notes, while the front desk only needs to see contact info and appointment times. How would you structure the database and application to handle this securely without making the app clunky?
2. **Zero-Downtime Updates:** We operate during normal clinic hours and can't afford the CRM to go down when we push an update or add a new feature. How will your Docker setup handle deploying new updates without interrupting our staff's workday?

If you have experience building secure web apps—especially in the medical space—please apply, share your past work, and let me know how you'd approach this project!

title: Automation Integration Specialist Needed
description:
We are looking for an experienced automation/integration specialist to build a workflow connecting our website chat/intake system with our legal CRM.

Project Goal

When a prospective client completes an online chat/intake, we want the system to automatically:

* Create or update the contact in our CRM
* Create a new lead/matter in the CRM's intake pipeline
* Populate the matter with the prospect's contact information
* Transfer relevant intake answers and chat information
* Add the chat transcript or summary as a note
* Populate lead source and other relevant fields
* Place the new matter into the appropriate initial status/stage
* Prevent duplicate contacts and duplicate matters when possible

We currently use established third-party platforms for online intake/chat, CRM, lead tracking, and workflow automation. Specific platform information will be provided to qualified applicants.

Required Experience

We are looking for someone with experience in:

* CRM integrations
* REST APIs
* Webhooks
* OAuth/API authentication
* Workflow automation platforms
* JSON/API request and response handling
* Contact and record matching/deduplication
* Mapping fields between different systems
* Error handling and logging

Experience integrating legal CRMs or professional-services intake systems is a plus.

Deliverables

The finished integration should:

1. Receive a completed chat/intake lead.
2. Search the CRM for an existing contact.
3. Create a contact if one does not already exist.
4. Create the appropriate intake matter/lead.
5. Associate the contact with the new matter.
6. Transfer relevant intake information into the matter.
7. Add the chat transcript or intake details.
8. Populate agreed-upon source and tracking fields.
9. Include safeguards against duplicate records.
10. Reliably handle authentication and API token refreshes if required.

The workflow should be documented so that we can understand how it operates and make basic changes later.

When Applying

Please briefly describe:

* Similar API or CRM integrations you have built
* Your experience working with automation platforms and webhooks
* Your approach to preventing duplicate contacts/records
* How you typically handle API authentication and token refresh
* Whether you can provide documentation of the finished workflow

Please include examples of comparable integration projects if available.

title: Experienced Developer Needed for 60-90 min Research Interview on AI Coding Agents

title: Landbot Developer Needed: Countdown Timer, Video Recording & Assessment Report
description:

title: Senior AI Engineer - Build an Agentic AI & RAG Enterprise Platform

PROJECT VISION

The platform will combine Agentic AI, RAG, LLMs, enterprise data integration, workflow automation, AI evaluation, observability, and security into one scalable system.

The long-term goal is to allow organizations to:

• Connect internal documents, databases, APIs, CRM/ERP systems, and knowledge sources

• Deploy specialized AI agents for different business functions
• Automate multi-step business processes
• Search and reason over large internal knowledge bases
• Generate reports, analysis, summaries, and recommendations

• Developing multi-agent and agentic AI workflows

• Contributing to security, privacy and AI governance architecture

• Python

• Make sound technical decisions independently
• Build prototypes and convert successful prototypes into production systems
• Evaluate different models and technologies objectively

title: Web Developer Needed to Build a Secure Healthcare CRM
description:
We are looking for an experienced developer to take on custom **CRM development** for our healthcare company. The off-the-shelf software we've tried doesn't fit our specific patient workflows, so we need a system built from scratch that actually works for our team.

Since we are dealing with sensitive patient information, security is our absolute top priority. The application must be 100% **HIPAA** compliant. We need someone who knows how to build secure access controls, audit logs, and keep patient data fully protected.

Here is what we are looking for technically:
*   **Web development:** A clean, easy-to-use web application that our staff can access directly from their browsers.
*   **PostgreSQL:** A robust, reliable database to store all of our patient and scheduling data securely. 
*   **Docker:** The application must be packaged using **Docker** so it's easy to deploy, update, and scale on our servers without breaking things.

**To weed out automated responses and make sure we are a good fit, please answer these two business questions in your proposal:**

1. **Role-Based Access:** In our clinic, our front desk staff and our medical practitioners will both use this CRM. However, practitioners need to see sensitive patient notes, while the front desk only needs to see contact info and appointment times. How would you structure the database and application to handle this securely without making the app clunky?
2. **Zero-Downtime Updates:** We operate during normal clinic hours and can't afford the CRM to go down when we push an update or add a new feature. How will your Docker setup handle deploying new updates without interrupting our staff's workday?

If you have experience building secure web apps—especially in the medical space—please apply, share your past work, and let me know how you'd approach this project!

title: Landbot Developer Needed: Countdown Timer, Video Recording & Assessment Report
description:
Landbot Developer Needed: Countdown Timer, Video Recording & Assessment Report

We currently have a BCG-style online case assessment simulation built and hosted on Landbot. The assessment is already fully functional, but we are looking for an experienced Landbot developer to implement several new features.

Scope of work

1. Assessment countdown timer

We currently track how long candidates take and show their completion time at the end.

We now want to:

- Display a visible countdown timer throughout the assessment
- Have the timer persist across the full Landbot flow
- When the timer reaches zero, show a pop-up/message telling the candidate that their time has expired
- Allow the candidate to continue and finish the assessment even after time expires
- Ensure the timer remains accurate as the candidate moves between questions/blocks

2. Video case conclusion

At the end of the assessment, candidates should complete a short case conclusion exercise:

- 1 minute to prepare their conclusion, with a countdown timer
- 1 minute to record and deliver their conclusion on video
- The candidate's response should be recorded within, or seamlessly connected to, the assessment experience
- The recorded response should be converted into a text transcript
- The candidate should then be able to compare their transcript with our model case conclusion

We are open to recommendations on the best technical solution for the video recording and speech-to-text functionality.

3. End-of-assessment performance report

We would also like to generate a personalised report for the candidate after completing the assessment.

The report should ideally include:

- Overall score
- Assessment completion time
- Question-by-question breakdown
- Candidate's answer for each question
- Our recommended answer
- Explanation for each answer
- Transcript of the candidate's final case conclusion
- Our model case conclusion

We are open to recommendations on whether the report should be displayed directly within Landbot, generated as a separate web page/PDF, or handled through another solution.

What we're looking for

You should have strong experience with:

- Landbot
- Custom JavaScript within Landbot
- Landbot Webhooks/APIs
- Third-party API integrations
- Video/audio recording integrations
- Speech-to-text solutions
- Building custom reporting/results experiences

This is not a basic Landbot flow-building project. We are specifically looking for someone comfortable implementing custom functionality and integrations.

title: Landbot Developer Needed: Countdown Timer, Video Recording & Assessment Report
description:
Landbot Developer Needed: Countdown Timer, Video Recording & Assessment Report

We currently have a BCG-style online case assessment simulation built and hosted on Landbot. The assessment is already fully functional, but we are looking for an experienced Landbot developer to implement several new features.

Scope of work

1. Assessment countdown timer

We currently track how long candidates take and show their completion time at the end.

We now want to:

- Display a visible countdown timer throughout the assessment
- Have the timer persist across the full Landbot flow
- When the timer reaches zero, show a pop-up/message telling the candidate that their time has expired
- Allow the candidate to continue and finish the assessment even after time expires
- Ensure the timer remains accurate as the candidate moves between questions/blocks

2. Video case conclusion

At the end of the assessment, candidates should complete a short case conclusion exercise:

- 1 minute to prepare their conclusion, with a countdown timer
- 1 minute to record and deliver their conclusion on video
- The candidate's response should be recorded within, or seamlessly connected to, the assessment experience
- The recorded response should be converted into a text transcript
- The candidate should then be able to compare their transcript with our model case conclusion

We are open to recommendations on the best technical solution for the video recording and speech-to-text functionality.

3. End-of-assessment performance report

We would also like to generate a personalised report for the candidate after completing the assessment.

The report should ideally include:

- Overall score
- Assessment completion time
- Question-by-question breakdown
- Candidate's answer for each question
- Our recommended answer
- Explanation for each answer
- Transcript of the candidate's final case conclusion
- Our model case conclusion

We are open to recommendations on whether the report should be displayed directly within Landbot, generated as a separate web page/PDF, or handled through another solution.

What we're looking for

You should have strong experience with:

- Landbot
- Custom JavaScript within Landbot
- Landbot Webhooks/APIs
- Third-party API integrations
- Video/audio recording integrations
- Speech-to-text solutions
- Building custom reporting/results experiences

title: Web Developer Needed to Build a Secure Healthcare CRM
description:
We are looking for an experienced developer to take on custom **CRM development** for our healthcare company. The off-the-shelf software we've tried doesn't fit our specific patient workflows, so we need a system built from scratch that actually works for our team.

Since we are dealing with sensitive patient information, security is our absolute top priority. The application must be 100% **HIPAA** compliant. We need someone who knows how to build secure access controls, audit logs, and keep patient data fully protected.

Here is what we are looking for technically:
*   **Web development:** A clean, easy-to-use web application that our staff can access directly from their browsers.
*   **PostgreSQL:** A robust, reliable database to store all of our patient and scheduling data securely. 
*   **Docker:** The application must be packaged using **Docker** so it's easy to deploy, update, and scale on our servers without breaking things.

**To weed out automated responses and make sure we are a good fit, please answer these two business questions in your proposal:**

1. **Role-Based Access:** In our clinic, our front desk staff and our medical practitioners will both use this CRM. However, practitioners need to see sensitive patient notes, while the front desk only needs to see contact info and appointment times. How would you structure the database and application to handle this securely without making the app clunky?
2. **Zero-Downtime Updates:** We operate during normal clinic hours and can't afford the CRM to go down when we push an update or add a new feature. How will your Docker setup handle deploying new updates without interrupting our staff's workday?

If you have experience building secure web apps—especially in the medical space—please apply, share your past work, and let me know how you'd approach this project!

title: Landbot Developer Needed: Countdown Timer, Video Recording & Assessment Report
description:
Landbot Developer Needed: Countdown Timer, Video Recording & Assessment Report

We currently have a BCG-style online case assessment simulation built and hosted on Landbot. The assessment is already fully functional, but we are looking for an experienced Landbot developer to implement several new features.

Scope of work

1. Assessment countdown timer

We currently track how long candidates take and show their completion time at the end.

We now want to:

- Display a visible countdown timer throughout the assessment
- Have the timer persist across the full Landbot flow
- When the timer reaches zero, show a pop-up/message telling the candidate that their time has expired
- Allow the candidate to continue and finish the assessment even after time expires
- Ensure the timer remains accurate as the candidate moves between questions/blocks

2. Video case conclusion

At the end of the assessment, candidates should complete a short case conclusion exercise:

- 1 minute to prepare their conclusion, with a countdown timer
- 1 minute to record and deliver their conclusion on video
- The candidate's response should be recorded within, or seamlessly connected to, the assessment experience
- The recorded response should be converted into a text transcript
- The candidate should then be able to compare their transcript with our model case conclusion

We are open to recommendations on the best technical solution for the video recording and speech-to-text functionality.

3. End-of-assessment performance report

We would also like to generate a personalised report for the candidate after completing the assessment.

The report should ideally include:

- Overall score
- Assessment completion time
- Question-by-question breakdown
- Candidate's answer for each question
- Our recommended answer
- Explanation for each answer
- Transcript of the candidate's final case conclusion
- Our model case conclusion

We are open to recommendations on whether the report should be displayed directly within Landbot, generated as a separate web page/PDF, or handled through another solution.

What we're looking for

You should have strong experience with:

- Landbot
- Custom JavaScript within Landbot
- Landbot Webhooks/APIs
- Third-party API integrations
- Video/audio recording integrations
- Speech-to-text solutions
- Building custom reporting/results experiences

This is not a basic Landbot flow-building project. We are specifically looking for someone comfortable implementing custom functionality and integrations.

* Database synchronization and background queues

* Production deployment and troubleshooting

title: Developer Needed to Diagnose Online Checkout / Payment Processing Error
description:
Web Developer Needed to Diagnose Checkout / Payment Processing Error Using Browser DevTools / Network Analysis”

I am looking for an experienced web developer or payment/API specialist to help diagnose a recurring checkout error I experience when purchasing tickets through Paciolan/eVenue college ticketing websites.

I am not looking to automate purchases, bypass website security, or modify the website. I only want to diagnose why a normal manual checkout attempt is failing.

The Problem

I can:

Log into the ticketing website normally
Select tickets
Add them to my cart
Enter billing and payment information

However, when I submit the order, the website returns a generic processing error and the purchase does not complete.

There are several possible causes, including:

Credit card/payment authorization
Billing address or AVS verification
Browser/session/cookies
Account-related issues
Network/IP-related issues
Website/API errors
Payment gateway or fraud/risk screening

I would like someone who can help determine where in the checkout process the transaction is failing and, if possible, identify the specific error being returned.

What I Need

I would like to screen-share while I perform a normal checkout attempt.

You should be comfortable using tools such as:

Chrome Developer Tools
Browser DevTools
Network Analysis
Network tab
Console
XHR/fetch requests
HTTP request/response analysis
HAR files
API debugging
Payment gateway troubleshooting

The goal is to inspect what happens when the order is submitted and determine whether the failure appears to occur:

In the browser/client
During an API request
At the ticketing platform
During payment processing
During address/payment verification
At another identifiable point in the checkout flow

If the browser receives an error code, HTTP status, API response, payment response, or other diagnostic information that isn't displayed to the customer, I would like that identified and explained.

Ideal Experience

Experience with any of the following would be especially useful:

E-commerce checkout debugging
Payment gateway integrations
Payment processing APIs
REST APIs
Chrome DevTools
HAR/network-log analysis
JavaScript debugging
Stripe, Adyen, Braintree, Authorize.net, CyberSource, Worldpay, or similar payment systems

Experience specifically with Paciolan/eVenue would be excellent but is not required.

This is primarily a diagnostic/troubleshooting project, not a programming or website-development project.

When responding, please briefly explain your experience diagnosing checkout/payment failures and whether you are comfortable analyzing browser Network/DevTools activity during a live screen-share session.

title: AI Shopping Assistant Development
description:
AI Shopping Assistant Developer – Amazon + SMS/Text MVP

Project Overview

We are looking for an experienced AI/full-stack developer to build an AI-powered shopping assistant.

For the first version, the system will focus only on Amazon and text/SMS. Voice calling and fully automated purchasing are not required for the MVP.

Customer Experience

The experience should be extremely simple.

For example, a customer texts:

“I need AA batteries.”

The system should:

1. Use AI to understand what the customer is looking for.
2. Search Amazon and find suitable products.
3. Compare relevant options based on factors such as price, ratings, specifications, and delivery.
4. Recommend a product to the customer with the important information and price.
5. Ask the customer to approve the purchase.
6. Once the customer says “Yes,” create a ready-to-purchase task for one of our employees.
7. The employee will manually complete the final purchase using the customer’s Amazon account.
8. The system should record the order information and send the customer confirmation/status information.

Amazon Accounts

Each customer will have their own Amazon account.

We need a secure and practical solution that allows our authorized employees to complete purchases on behalf of customers.

Security is extremely important. We want the developer to recommend the proper architecture for handling customer account access and payment-related information rather than simply storing passwords or raw credit-card information insecurely.

Employee/Admin Dashboard

Our employees need a dashboard where they can:

* See new customer shopping requests
* See the exact Amazon product the customer approved
* See the customer’s relevant order/delivery information
* Complete/manage purchasing tasks
* Update order status
* View customer and order history
* Handle requests that require human assistance
* See failed or unresolved AI requests

SMS/Text

Customers should be able to interact with the AI through normal SMS/text messaging.

Voice calling is not required for Version 1, but we may add AI voice calling later.

Scale

The system should be architected to support at least 200 customers actively using the service concurrently without significant performance degradation.

Future Expansion

Although Version 1 will focus on Amazon, the architecture should be designed so we can later add additional retailers such as Walmart, Target, eBay, and others without rebuilding the entire platform.

We may also add automatic purchasing/checkout in the future where technically and legally supported.

Developer Requirements

We are looking for someone experienced with:

* AI/LLM integrations and AI agents
* Full-stack application development
* E-commerce/product search integrations
* Amazon product data/integrations
* SMS APIs
* Secure authentication and customer data
* Payment security/tokenization
* Databases and scalable cloud infrastructure
* Employee/admin dashboards
* API integrations
* Building production-ready systems

When Applying

Please include:

1. How you would architect this system.
2. How you would obtain reliable Amazon product information, including current pricing and availability.
3. How you would securely handle customer Amazon account access.
4. Which AI, SMS, database, hosting, and other APIs/services you recommend.
5. How you would design the system so additional retailers can be added later.
6. How you would design it to support at least 200 concurrent customers.
7. Your estimated timeline and total cost for the MVP.
8. Examples of similar AI, e-commerce, SMS, or automation systems you have built.

Please do not send a generic proposal. We are specifically interested in developers who can explain how they would approach the Amazon integration and customer account security.

title: Section 8 Investment Acquisition
description:
Project Overview

I am looking for an experienced AI automation developer to build a complete 24/7 AI-powered Section 8 real estate acquisition and underwriting system.

This is not a basic chatbot or simple automation project.

The goal is to create an AI system that continuously identifies potential investment properties, evaluates them against my investment criteria, underwrites each opportunity, rejects weak deals, ranks strong opportunities, and alerts me when a property meets my acquisition standards.

Core System Requirements

The system should be capable of:

* Continuously searching available investment properties
* Target purchase price: approximately $100,000–$350,000
* Prioritizing 3+ bedroom properties
* Analyzing HUD / Housing Choice Voucher rent potential
* Evaluating neighborhood quality
* Reviewing available crime/safety data
* Evaluating proximity to schools, supermarkets, highways and other amenities
* Estimating property taxes, insurance, property management, maintenance, vacancy and other operating expenses
* Calculating:
    * Monthly cash flow
    * Cash-on-cash ROI
    * Cap rate
    * DSCR
    * Estimated acquisition costs
* Automatically rejecting properties that fail predetermined criteria
* Assigning qualified properties an investment/deal score
* Ranking opportunities from strongest to weakest
* Sending alerts when high-quality opportunities are identified

Preferred Data / Integrations

Potential integrations may include:

* HUD/HUDUser data
* Property listing/data providers
* Mashvisor
* InvestorLift/InvestorList or similar investor-property sources where API/access permits
* Crime/neighborhood data providers
* Mapping/location APIs
* Property tax/public-record data
* Insurance/expense estimation sources

I understand some platforms may have API, licensing, or data-access restrictions. The developer should recommend compliant alternatives when direct integrations are unavailable.

Automation / Technology

I am open to:

* n8n
* AI/LLM agents
* APIs
* Databases
* Webhooks
* Scheduled workflows
* Custom backend services where necessary

The architecture should be reliable enough to operate continuously without requiring me to manually search properties every day.

Dashboard

I want a dashboard that allows me to see:

* New opportunities
* Property information
* Asking price
* Estimated Section 8 rent
* Estimated expenses
* Cash flow
* ROI
* Cap rate
* DSCR
* Neighborhood analysis
* Deal score
* Pass/reject status
* Reason a property passed or failed

Human Approval

The AI should not purchase properties or make binding financial decisions automatically.

The system identifies and analyzes opportunities.

I make the final acquisition decision.

Deliverables

I expect the developer to deliver:

1. Complete working MVP
2. AI/automation workflows
3. Required API integrations
4. Database
5. Deal-scoring/underwriting engine
6. Dashboard
7. Alert system
8. Error handling and monitoring
9. Documentation
10. Deployment instructions
11. Source code/workflows
12. Ownership/administrator access to the completed system

Developer Requirements

Please apply only if you have experience building end-to-end AI automation systems, not simply individual workflows.

Your proposal should include:

* Examples of comparable AI/n8n systems you have personally built
* Recommended architecture
* APIs/data sources you would use
* Estimated MVP development time
* Fixed-price or milestone-based quote
* Expected monthly API/data/hosting costs
* What components would require paid third-party subscriptions
* What ongoing maintenance would be required

Please also identify any part of this specification that you believe cannot be reliably automated and explain the alternative you recommend.

My objective is to build a scalable Section 8 acquisition engine that can operate 24/7 while keeping final investment approval under human control.

title: AI Shopping Assistant Development
description:
AI Shopping Assistant Developer – Amazon + SMS/Text MVP

Project Overview

We are looking for an experienced AI/full-stack developer to build an AI-powered shopping assistant.

For the first version, the system will focus only on Amazon and text/SMS. Voice calling and fully automated purchasing are not required for the MVP.

Customer Experience

The experience should be extremely simple.

For example, a customer texts:

“I need AA batteries.”

The system should:

1. Use AI to understand what the customer is looking for.
2. Search Amazon and find suitable products.
3. Compare relevant options based on factors such as price, ratings, specifications, and delivery.
4. Recommend a product to the customer with the important information and price.
5. Ask the customer to approve the purchase.
6. Once the customer says “Yes,” create a ready-to-purchase task for one of our employees.
7. The employee will manually complete the final purchase using the customer’s Amazon account.
8. The system should record the order information and send the customer confirmation/status information.

Amazon Accounts

Each customer will have their own Amazon account.

We need a secure and practical solution that allows our authorized employees to complete purchases on behalf of customers.

Security is extremely important. We want the developer to recommend the proper architecture for handling customer account access and payment-related information rather than simply storing passwords or raw credit-card information insecurely.

Employee/Admin Dashboard

Our employees need a dashboard where they can:

* See new customer shopping requests
* See the exact Amazon product the customer approved
* See the customer’s relevant order/delivery information
* Complete/manage purchasing tasks
* Update order status
* View customer and order history
* Handle requests that require human assistance
* See failed or unresolved AI requests

SMS/Text

Customers should be able to interact with the AI through normal SMS/text messaging.

Voice calling is not required for Version 1, but we may add AI voice calling later.

Scale

The system should be architected to support at least 200 customers actively using the service concurrently without significant performance degradation.

Future Expansion

Although Version 1 will focus on Amazon, the architecture should be designed so we can later add additional retailers such as Walmart, Target, eBay, and others without rebuilding the entire platform.

We may also add automatic purchasing/checkout in the future where technically and legally supported.

Developer Requirements

We are looking for someone experienced with:

* AI/LLM integrations and AI agents
* Full-stack application development
* E-commerce/product search integrations
* Amazon product data/integrations
* SMS APIs
* Secure authentication and customer data
* Payment security/tokenization
* Databases and scalable cloud infrastructure
* Employee/admin dashboards
* API integrations
* Building production-ready systems

When Applying

Please include:

1. How you would architect this system.
2. How you would obtain reliable Amazon product information, including current pricing and availability.
3. How you would securely handle customer Amazon account access.
4. Which AI, SMS, database, hosting, and other APIs/services you recommend.
5. How you would design the system so additional retailers can be added later.
6. How you would design it to support at least 200 concurrent customers.
7. Your estimated timeline and total cost for the MVP.
8. Examples of similar AI, e-commerce, SMS, or automation systems you have built.

Please do not send a generic proposal. We are specifically interested in developers who can explain how they would approach the Amazon integration and customer account security.

title: Landbot Developer Needed: Countdown Timer, Video Recording & Assessment Report
description:
Landbot Developer Needed: Countdown Timer, Video Recording & Assessment Report

We currently have a BCG-style online case assessment simulation built and hosted on Landbot. The assessment is already fully functional, but we are looking for an experienced Landbot developer to implement several new features.

Scope of work

1. Assessment countdown timer

We currently track how long candidates take and show their completion time at the end.

We now want to:

- Display a visible countdown timer throughout the assessment
- Have the timer persist across the full Landbot flow
- When the timer reaches zero, show a pop-up/message telling the candidate that their time has expired
- Allow the candidate to continue and finish the assessment even after time expires
- Ensure the timer remains accurate as the candidate moves between questions/blocks

2. Video case conclusion

At the end of the assessment, candidates should complete a short case conclusion exercise:

- 1 minute to prepare their conclusion, with a countdown timer
- 1 minute to record and deliver their conclusion on video
- The candidate's response should be recorded within, or seamlessly connected to, the assessment experience
- The recorded response should be converted into a text transcript
- The candidate should then be able to compare their transcript with our model case conclusion

We are open to recommendations on the best technical solution for the video recording and speech-to-text functionality.

3. End-of-assessment performance report

We would also like to generate a personalised report for the candidate after completing the assessment.

The report should ideally include:

- Overall score
- Assessment completion time
- Question-by-question breakdown
- Candidate's answer for each question
- Our recommended answer
- Explanation for each answer
- Transcript of the candidate's final case conclusion
- Our model case conclusion

We are open to recommendations on whether the report should be displayed directly within Landbot, generated as a separate web page/PDF, or handled through another solution.

What we're looking for

You should have strong experience with:

- Landbot
- Custom JavaScript within Landbot
- Landbot Webhooks/APIs
- Third-party API integrations
- Video/audio recording integrations
- Speech-to-text solutions
- Building custom reporting/results experiences

This is not a basic Landbot flow-building project. We are specifically looking for someone comfortable implementing custom functionality and integrations.

title: Developer Needed to Diagnose Online Checkout / Payment Processing Error
description:
Web Developer Needed to Diagnose Checkout / Payment Processing Error Using Browser DevTools / Network Analysis”

I am looking for an experienced web developer or payment/API specialist to help diagnose a recurring checkout error I experience when purchasing tickets through Paciolan/eVenue college ticketing websites.

I am not looking to automate purchases, bypass website security, or modify the website. I only want to diagnose why a normal manual checkout attempt is failing.

The Problem

I can:

Log into the ticketing website normally
Select tickets
Add them to my cart
Enter billing and payment information

However, when I submit the order, the website returns a generic processing error and the purchase does not complete.

There are several possible causes, including:

Credit card/payment authorization
Billing address or AVS verification
Browser/session/cookies
Account-related issues
Network/IP-related issues
Website/API errors
Payment gateway or fraud/risk screening

I would like someone who can help determine where in the checkout process the transaction is failing and, if possible, identify the specific error being returned.

What I Need

I would like to screen-share while I perform a normal checkout attempt.

You should be comfortable using tools such as:

Chrome Developer Tools
Browser DevTools
Network Analysis
Network tab
Console
XHR/fetch requests
HTTP request/response analysis
HAR files
API debugging
Payment gateway troubleshooting

The goal is to inspect what happens when the order is submitted and determine whether the failure appears to occur:

In the browser/client
During an API request
At the ticketing platform
During payment processing
During address/payment verification
At another identifiable point in the checkout flow

If the browser receives an error code, HTTP status, API response, payment response, or other diagnostic information that isn't displayed to the customer, I would like that identified and explained.

Ideal Experience

Experience with any of the following would be especially useful:

E-commerce checkout debugging
Payment gateway integrations
Payment processing APIs
REST APIs
Chrome DevTools
HAR/network-log analysis
JavaScript debugging
Stripe, Adyen, Braintree, Authorize.net, CyberSource, Worldpay, or similar payment systems

Experience specifically with Paciolan/eVenue would be excellent but is not required.

This is primarily a diagnostic/troubleshooting project, not a programming or website-development project.

When responding, please briefly explain your experience diagnosing checkout/payment failures and whether you are comfortable analyzing browser Network/DevTools activity during a live screen-share session.

title: Full-stack AI engineer: coding agents, GEO platform
description:
AISEO builds the platform that gets businesses mentioned by AI. When someone asks ChatGPT, Claude, or Perplexity for a recommendation, we make sure our customers are in the answer. This is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and we think it replaces a large part of what SEO used to be.

We are a small team and we build the way the best small teams build now: engineers driving fleets of coding agents. We are hiring one more person who works this way natively.

What this role is:

You build the agents inside our GEO platform. Crawlers that check how LLMs talk about a brand, pipelines that generate and place content answer engines actually cite, monitors that track mentions across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and AI Overviews, and tooling that makes a business legible to LLMs (think llms.txt, structured docs, machine-readable product data). You own these systems end to end: design, build, ship, measure.

You also build with agents, not just for them. We expect you to run Claude Code or Codex as your primary way of producing software, and to be good at loop engineering: turning a goal into a prompt plus a verifiable completion condition, then letting agents iterate overnight until it holds. Backlog burndowns, fix-until-green loops, eval-driven content pipelines. If you have never left an agent running while you slept, this role will be a stretch.

What we look for:
- You use coding agents as your default. You decompose work, write prompts that hold up over long runs, manage context windows, and run several agents in parallel without losing the thread.
- You have built agent loops with real completion criteria, not just chat sessions. You know why "keep going until the tests pass" needs guardrails and what those guardrails are.
- You have shipped LLM-powered products: prompting, evals, retrieval, structured output, cost and latency tradeoffs, multi-provider routing (OpenAI, Anthropic, open models).
- You are a solid full-stack engineer underneath it all: TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node.js, and Python, with production APIs, data models, and deploys (GCP preferred) behind you.
- You read every diff an agent produces and catch its shortcuts. Agent fluency without engineering judgment is how bad code ships fast.

Nice to have:
- You understand how AI is changing search: AI Overviews, answer engines, citation behavior, semantic search, vector databases.
- You have experimented with MCP servers, agent skills, or tool-use APIs.
- You have taken a side project from idea to launch on your own.
- You have opinions about how businesses should present themselves to LLMs, and can defend them.

What you will work on:
- Agents that audit and improve a brand's presence in LLM answers.
- Content and data pipelines optimized to get cited by answer engines.
- Tooling that makes customers' products discoverable and citable by LLMs.
- The evals and monitoring that prove all of the above actually moves mentions.

How to apply:
Send two things.

1. Three pieces of evidence of exceptional ability. Anything that proves you operate at a level most engineers do not: products you shipped solo, agents you built, loops that ran unattended and produced real results, open-source work people use, numbers you moved. Links and artifacts beat descriptions. Pick your best three, not your most recent three.
2. Your understanding of GEO (max 300 words). How do LLMs decide which businesses to mention in an answer? What actually moves citations in ChatGPT, Claude, or Perplexity, and what is noise? What agent would you build first to get a brand mentioned more, and how would you know it worked? We want to see you have thought about this, not just read a blog post about it.

We read for evidence and judgment. A strong submission from someone with three years of experience beats a generic one from someone with ten.

title: Full stack SAAS developer to finish existing app- stripe, Cloudflare, admin dashboard
Full-Stack Developer / Team Needed to Build Pharmacy Marketplace & E-Prescribing Platform
description:
We are looking for an experienced full-stack developer, technical lead, or small development team to build a modern healthcare/pharmacy technology platform similar in concept to Ironsail Pharma / ImpetusOne and VITL Rx.

This will be a multi-tenant B2B healthcare SaaS platform connecting medical practices, providers, pharmacies, and eventually patients through one centralized system.

We are not building a pharmacy.

We are building the technology and marketplace layer that connects healthcare organizations with multiple independent pharmacy partners.

What We Want to Build

The goal is to create one platform where a clinic or provider can:

* Create and manage patients
* Select medications/formulations
* Compare available pharmacy partners
* View pharmacy pricing
* See which pharmacies can service a patient’s state
* Submit prescription/order information
* Route prescriptions/orders to the appropriate pharmacy
* Track prescription status
* Track fulfillment
* Receive shipment/tracking information
* Manage refills
* Communicate regarding prescription issues
* View all pharmacy activity from one dashboard

Instead of a clinic having separate accounts and portals with 5–20 different pharmacies, we want them to have one account, one interface, and one workflow.

Pharmacy Marketplace

The platform should support multiple pharmacy partners.

Each pharmacy should have configurable information including:

* States serviced
* Pharmacy type
* 503A / 503B / retail / specialty
* Medication catalog
* Formulations
* Strengths
* Dosage forms
* Pharmacy cost
* Shipping costs
* Estimated turnaround time
* Fulfillment capabilities
* API/integration method
* Active/inactive medications
* Active/inactive states

When a provider selects a medication, the system should be able to display eligible pharmacies based on criteria such as:

Patient State + Medication + Formulation + Pharmacy Licensure + Availability

Eventually we would like intelligent routing and preferred pharmacy rules.

Initial Integration Strategy

We do NOT need every pharmacy fully API-integrated on day one.

We want an architecture that allows multiple connection methods.

For example:

API Pharmacy

Order and patient data can be transmitted through REST API and status updates returned automatically.

Portal / Manual Pharmacy

Our administrative team can process orders through the pharmacy’s existing portal while the clinic still sees everything through our platform.

Secure Fax / eRx Pharmacy

The provider sends the legal prescription through an existing e-prescribing solution while our system manages the patient/order/fulfillment workflow.

CSV / Batch Pharmacy

Our system generates structured files that can be uploaded to a pharmacy partner.

The objective is to launch quickly and automate progressively, rather than spending months integrating every pharmacy before going live.

Provider / Clinic Dashboard

Clinics should be able to:

* Create/manage patients
* Manage providers
* Search medications
* Browse pharmacy options
* Compare pricing
* Create prescription/order workflows
* Select pharmacy
* View current orders
* View order status
* View tracking
* Manage refills
* View patient history
* Receive alerts when an order has an issue
* Manage billing/account settings

We want a very modern, simple UI.

Think:

Stripe + Shopify + modern telehealth software

rather than a traditional outdated pharmacy system.

Pharmacy Dashboard

Participating pharmacies should eventually have their own portal.

Pharmacy users should be able to:

* View incoming orders
* Review patient/order information
* Accept orders
* Flag an order/problem
* Update order status
* Enter or automatically provide tracking
* Manage supported medications
* Manage pricing
* Manage states serviced
* View order history
* View reporting

Possible statuses:

Pending Prescription

Received

Pharmacist Review

Processing

Ready for Shipment

Shipped

Delivered

Issue / Action Required

Admin / Marketplace Dashboard

Our internal team needs a powerful admin interface.

We should be able to manage:

* Clinics
* Providers
* Patients
* Pharmacies
* Pharmacy credentials
* Pharmacy states
* Medication catalog
* Formulations
* Pricing
* Orders
* Prescription status
* Shipping/tracking
* Support issues
* Pharmacy performance
* User permissions
* Agreements/documents
* Financial reporting
* Platform fees
* Analytics

We also want the ability to configure which clinics can see which pharmacies, products, and pricing.

Medication Catalog

We need a centralized master medication/product catalog.

For example:

Medication

→ formulation

→ strength

→ dosage form

→ pharmacy

→ pharmacy SKU

→ pharmacy cost

→ shipping

→ states available

The same medication may be offered by multiple pharmacies at different prices and formulations.

The architecture needs to support this cleanly.

E-Prescribing

We eventually want integrated e-prescribing.

Experience with any of the following is highly valuable:

* Surescripts
* DrFirst
* DoseSpot
* Photon
* Rcopia
* SureScripts-certified vendors
* EPCS
* NCPDP SCRIPT
* pharmacy management systems

For V1, we are open to integrating an established e-prescribing vendor rather than attempting to build an e-prescribing network ourselves.

We specifically want someone who understands the difference between:

the prescription

and

the pharmacy order / fulfillment workflow.

APIs & Integrations

The platform should be built API-first.

We expect future integrations with:

* Pharmacy APIs
* EHRs
* Telehealth platforms
* e-prescribing vendors
* Stripe
* shipping/tracking providers
* SMS
* email
* webhook systems
* potentially Shopify / WooCommerce
* potentially laboratory platforms

We will also eventually expose our own API so outside telehealth companies can use our pharmacy network without using our full user interface.

Example:

Telehealth Platform → Our API → Pharmacy Network

White-Label Capability

Long term, we want the platform to support white labeling.

A healthcare organization should potentially be able to use:

pharmacy.theirbrand.com

with:

* Their logo
* Their colors
* Their pharmacy marketplace configuration
* Their users
* Their preferred pharmacy network

This means the system should be designed as a proper multi-tenant SaaS architecture from the beginning.

HIPAA / Security

Because this system will handle PHI, experience building HIPAA-compliant healthcare software is strongly preferred.

We expect proper implementation of:

* Role-based access control
* Encryption in transit
* Encryption at rest
* Audit logs
* Secure authentication
* MFA capability
* Session security
* Proper cloud architecture
* Database access controls
* Backups
* Logging
* Business Associate Agreement-compatible vendors

Please do not apply if your only experience is building basic WordPress sites or simple consumer applications.

Suggested Technical Architecture

We are open to recommendations.

Possible stack:

Frontend

* React
* Next.js
* TypeScript

Backend

* Node.js / NestJS
* Python / FastAPI
* Laravel
* Other modern scalable architecture

Database

* PostgreSQL

Cloud

* AWS
* Azure
* Google Cloud

We care more about clean architecture and speed of execution than a particular programming language.

Phase 1 / MVP

We do NOT want to overbuild V1.

The first version should focus on:

1. Authentication and multi-tenant organizations
2. Clinic dashboard
3. Patient management
4. Provider management
5. Pharmacy management
6. Medication/catalog management
7. Pharmacy/state eligibility rules
8. Pharmacy pricing
9. Creating orders
10. Assigning/routing orders to pharmacies
11. Order status management
12. Shipment/tracking information
13. Admin dashboard
14. Basic pharmacy dashboard
15. Notifications
16. Audit logging
17. Initial payment integration
18. Architecture for future APIs

If a pharmacy does not initially have an API, our staff should be able to manually process that order while maintaining the exact same user experience for the clinic.

That is important.

We want to get V1 into production quickly instead of waiting for every outside integration.

Phase 2

After proving the workflow:

* Pharmacy API integrations
* Automated status updates
* Integrated e-prescribing
* Pharmacy comparison engine
* Advanced pricing rules
* Automated routing
* Patient portal
* Patient payments
* Automated refills
* Advanced reporting
* External API
* Webhooks
* White-label deployments

Phase 3

Eventually we envision this becoming a significant healthcare infrastructure platform connecting:

Healthcare Practices

↓

Our Technology / Marketplace

↓

503A Pharmacies | 503B Pharmacies | Retail Pharmacies | Specialty Pharmacies

↓

Patients

Who We Want

We would strongly prefer someone who has previously built or integrated:

* Healthcare SaaS
* Pharmacy software
* EHR software
* Telehealth platforms
* Prescription workflows
* Healthcare marketplaces
* Multi-vendor marketplaces
* HIPAA systems
* Surescripts
* DrFirst
* DoseSpot
* Photon
* Pharmacy APIs
* Healthcare interoperability
* HL7 / FHIR
* NCPDP
* Multi-tenant SaaS

You do NOT necessarily need pharmacy experience if you are an exceptional SaaS architect with strong API and healthcare experience.

When Applying

Please start your proposal with the words:

PHARMACY PLATFORM

This lets us know you actually read the posting.

Then answer these questions:

1. Have you built healthcare, pharmacy, EHR, telehealth, or e-prescribing software before?
2. Please provide links/screenshots/examples.
3. Have you integrated with Surescripts, DrFirst, DoseSpot, Photon, or another eRx provider?
4. Have you integrated directly with pharmacies or pharmacy management systems?
5. Have you built a multi-vendor marketplace?
6. Have you built multi-tenant SaaS software?
7. What technology stack would you recommend for this project?
8. If we intentionally keep the first version lean, how would you architect the MVP?
9. What features would you leave OUT of V1 so that we can launch faster?
10. Are you an individual developer, technical lead, or agency?
11. Who will actually write the code?
12. Are you available for ongoing development after the MVP?

Important

We are looking for someone who thinks like a technical co-founder / product architect, not simply someone waiting for us to provide detailed instructions for every screen.

We understand the healthcare business and pharmacy workflow.

We want someone who can help us determine:

What needs to be built now

vs.

What can be integrated later

vs.

What should not be built ourselves at all.

If you have already worked on a pharmacy marketplace, healthcare marketplace, prescription platform, telehealth infrastructure product, or pharmacy API integration, we especially want to speak with you.

Please include your estimated MVP budget range, proposed team, recommended architecture, and examples of the most relevant work you have completed.

description:

Your first 3 months will be focused on building our “First Fix” master template that we can clone for new clients. After that, you’ll integrate into the team and own at least 5 client projects at once without becoming a bottleneck.

What You’ll Do (First 3 Months – First Fix)

title: Full-Stack Developer / Team Needed to Build Pharmacy Marketplace & E-Prescribing Platform
description:
We are looking for an experienced full-stack developer, technical lead, or small development team to build a modern healthcare/pharmacy technology platform similar in concept to Ironsail Pharma / ImpetusOne and VITL Rx.

This will be a multi-tenant B2B healthcare SaaS platform connecting medical practices, providers, pharmacies, and eventually patients through one centralized system.

We are not building a pharmacy.

We are building the technology and marketplace layer that connects healthcare organizations with multiple independent pharmacy partners.

What We Want to Build

The goal is to create one platform where a clinic or provider can:

* Create and manage patients
* Select medications/formulations
* Compare available pharmacy partners
* View pharmacy pricing
* See which pharmacies can service a patient’s state
* Submit prescription/order information
* Route prescriptions/orders to the appropriate pharmacy
* Track prescription status
* Track fulfillment
* Receive shipment/tracking information
* Manage refills
* Communicate regarding prescription issues
* View all pharmacy activity from one dashboard

Instead of a clinic having separate accounts and portals with 5–20 different pharmacies, we want them to have one account, one interface, and one workflow.

Pharmacy Marketplace

The platform should support multiple pharmacy partners.

Each pharmacy should have configurable information including:

* States serviced
* Pharmacy type
* 503A / 503B / retail / specialty
* Medication catalog
* Formulations
* Strengths
* Dosage forms
* Pharmacy cost
* Shipping costs
* Estimated turnaround time
* Fulfillment capabilities
* API/integration method
* Active/inactive medications
* Active/inactive states

When a provider selects a medication, the system should be able to display eligible pharmacies based on criteria such as:

Patient State + Medication + Formulation + Pharmacy Licensure + Availability

Eventually we would like intelligent routing and preferred pharmacy rules.

Initial Integration Strategy

We do NOT need every pharmacy fully API-integrated on day one.

We want an architecture that allows multiple connection methods.

For example:

API Pharmacy

Order and patient data can be transmitted through REST API and status updates returned automatically.

Portal / Manual Pharmacy

Our administrative team can process orders through the pharmacy’s existing portal while the clinic still sees everything through our platform.

Secure Fax / eRx Pharmacy

The provider sends the legal prescription through an existing e-prescribing solution while our system manages the patient/order/fulfillment workflow.

CSV / Batch Pharmacy

Our system generates structured files that can be uploaded to a pharmacy partner.

The objective is to launch quickly and automate progressively, rather than spending months integrating every pharmacy before going live.

Provider / Clinic Dashboard

Clinics should be able to:

* Create/manage patients
* Manage providers
* Search medications
* Browse pharmacy options
* Compare pricing
* Create prescription/order workflows
* Select pharmacy
* View current orders
* View order status
* View tracking
* Manage refills
* View patient history
* Receive alerts when an order has an issue
* Manage billing/account settings

We want a very modern, simple UI.

Think:

Stripe + Shopify + modern telehealth software

rather than a traditional outdated pharmacy system.

Pharmacy Dashboard

Participating pharmacies should eventually have their own portal.

Pharmacy users should be able to:

* View incoming orders
* Review patient/order information
* Accept orders
* Flag an order/problem
* Update order status
* Enter or automatically provide tracking
* Manage supported medications
* Manage pricing
* Manage states serviced
* View order history
* View reporting

Possible statuses:

Pending Prescription

Received

Pharmacist Review

Processing

Ready for Shipment

Shipped

Delivered

Issue / Action Required

Admin / Marketplace Dashboard

Our internal team needs a powerful admin interface.

We should be able to manage:

* Clinics
* Providers
* Patients
* Pharmacies
* Pharmacy credentials
* Pharmacy states
* Medication catalog
* Formulations
* Pricing
* Orders
* Prescription status
* Shipping/tracking
* Support issues
* Pharmacy performance
* User permissions
* Agreements/documents
* Financial reporting
* Platform fees
* Analytics

We also want the ability to configure which clinics can see which pharmacies, products, and pricing.

Medication Catalog

We need a centralized master medication/product catalog.

For example:

Medication

→ formulation

→ strength

→ dosage form

→ pharmacy

→ pharmacy SKU

→ pharmacy cost

→ shipping

→ states available

The same medication may be offered by multiple pharmacies at different prices and formulations.

The architecture needs to support this cleanly.

E-Prescribing

We eventually want integrated e-prescribing.

Experience with any of the following is highly valuable:

* Surescripts
* DrFirst
* DoseSpot
* Photon
* Rcopia
* SureScripts-certified vendors
* EPCS
* NCPDP SCRIPT
* pharmacy management systems

For V1, we are open to integrating an established e-prescribing vendor rather than attempting to build an e-prescribing network ourselves.

We specifically want someone who understands the difference between:

the prescription

and

the pharmacy order / fulfillment workflow.

APIs & Integrations

The platform should be built API-first.

We expect future integrations with:

* Pharmacy APIs
* EHRs
* Telehealth platforms
* e-prescribing vendors
* Stripe
* shipping/tracking providers
* SMS
* email
* webhook systems
* potentially Shopify / WooCommerce
* potentially laboratory platforms

We will also eventually expose our own API so outside telehealth companies can use our pharmacy network without using our full user interface.

Example:

Telehealth Platform → Our API → Pharmacy Network

White-Label Capability

Long term, we want the platform to support white labeling.

A healthcare organization should potentially be able to use:

pharmacy.theirbrand.com

with:

* Their logo
* Their colors
* Their pharmacy marketplace configuration
* Their users
* Their preferred pharmacy network

This means the system should be designed as a proper multi-tenant SaaS architecture from the beginning.

HIPAA / Security

Because this system will handle PHI, experience building HIPAA-compliant healthcare software is strongly preferred.

We expect proper implementation of:

* Role-based access control
* Encryption in transit
* Encryption at rest
* Audit logs
* Secure authentication
* MFA capability
* Session security
* Proper cloud architecture
* Database access controls
* Backups
* Logging
* Business Associate Agreement-compatible vendors

Please do not apply if your only experience is building basic WordPress sites or simple consumer applications.

Suggested Technical Architecture

We are open to recommendations.

Possible stack:

Frontend

* React
* Next.js
* TypeScript

Backend

* Node.js / NestJS
* Python / FastAPI
* Laravel
* Other modern scalable architecture

Database

* PostgreSQL

Cloud

* AWS
* Azure
* Google Cloud

We care more about clean architecture and speed of execution than a particular programming language.

Phase 1 / MVP

We do NOT want to overbuild V1.

The first version should focus on:

1. Authentication and multi-tenant organizations
2. Clinic dashboard
3. Patient management
4. Provider management
5. Pharmacy management
6. Medication/catalog management
7. Pharmacy/state eligibility rules
8. Pharmacy pricing
9. Creating orders
10. Assigning/routing orders to pharmacies
11. Order status management
12. Shipment/tracking information
13. Admin dashboard
14. Basic pharmacy dashboard
15. Notifications
16. Audit logging
17. Initial payment integration
18. Architecture for future APIs

If a pharmacy does not initially have an API, our staff should be able to manually process that order while maintaining the exact same user experience for the clinic.

That is important.

We want to get V1 into production quickly instead of waiting for every outside integration.

Phase 2

After proving the workflow:

* Pharmacy API integrations
* Automated status updates
* Integrated e-prescribing
* Pharmacy comparison engine
* Advanced pricing rules
* Automated routing
* Patient portal
* Patient payments
* Automated refills
* Advanced reporting
* External API
* Webhooks
* White-label deployments

Phase 3

Eventually we envision this becoming a significant healthcare infrastructure platform connecting:

Healthcare Practices

↓

Our Technology / Marketplace

↓

503A Pharmacies | 503B Pharmacies | Retail Pharmacies | Specialty Pharmacies

↓

Patients

Who We Want

We would strongly prefer someone who has previously built or integrated:

* Healthcare SaaS
* Pharmacy software
* EHR software
* Telehealth platforms
* Prescription workflows
* Healthcare marketplaces
* Multi-vendor marketplaces
* HIPAA systems
* Surescripts
* DrFirst
* DoseSpot
* Photon
* Pharmacy APIs
* Healthcare interoperability
* HL7 / FHIR
* NCPDP
* Multi-tenant SaaS

You do NOT necessarily need pharmacy experience if you are an exceptional SaaS architect with strong API and healthcare experience.

When Applying

Please start your proposal with the words:

PHARMACY PLATFORM

This lets us know you actually read the posting.

Then answer these questions:

1. Have you built healthcare, pharmacy, EHR, telehealth, or e-prescribing software before?
2. Please provide links/screenshots/examples.
3. Have you integrated with Surescripts, DrFirst, DoseSpot, Photon, or another eRx provider?
4. Have you integrated directly with pharmacies or pharmacy management systems?
5. Have you built a multi-vendor marketplace?
6. Have you built multi-tenant SaaS software?
7. What technology stack would you recommend for this project?
8. If we intentionally keep the first version lean, how would you architect the MVP?
9. What features would you leave OUT of V1 so that we can launch faster?
10. Are you an individual developer, technical lead, or agency?
11. Who will actually write the code?
12. Are you available for ongoing development after the MVP?

Important

We are looking for someone who thinks like a technical co-founder / product architect, not simply someone waiting for us to provide detailed instructions for every screen.

We understand the healthcare business and pharmacy workflow.

We want someone who can help us determine:

What needs to be built now

vs.

What can be integrated later

vs.

What should not be built ourselves at all.

If you have already worked on a pharmacy marketplace, healthcare marketplace, prescription platform, telehealth infrastructure product, or pharmacy API integration, we especially want to speak with you.

Please include your estimated MVP budget range, proposed team, recommended architecture, and examples of the most relevant work you have completed.

title: LLM/RAG Pipeline Developer — AI Legal Document Risk-Analysis SaaS (MVP)

title: Revenue Credit AI — GoHighLevel Transfer, Integration & A2P Setup
description:
Project Overview

I am looking for an experienced GoHighLevel (GHL) developer/integration specialist to take over and complete work on an existing web platform called Revenue Credit AI.

The platform has already been professionally developed and is currently functional. My existing developer is stepping away because he is having a baby and has prepared a detailed developer handoff package explaining the architecture, deployment, codebase, credentials needed, and remaining GoHighLevel work.

This is NOT a website rebuild. I need someone who can review the existing system, follow the developer handoff, connect everything properly with GoHighLevel, and make sure the system is working correctly from beginning to end.

The complete developer handoff documentation will be provided as an attachment.

Current Platform

Revenue Credit AI is built with:

Next.js / TypeScript
Supabase for authentication, database, and file storage
Stripe for payments
OpenAI for AI-assisted dispute letter generation
Resend for transactional emails
Vercel for hosting
GitHub for source code
Twilio currently handles limited SMS notifications
GoHighLevel is already being used for our booking calendar

The website, client dashboard, admin dashboard, payments, document uploads, dispute tracking, AI letter generation, email notifications, and other major functionality are already built.

Main Scope of Work

I need the new developer to:

Review the complete developer handoff documentation and existing Revenue Credit AI codebase.
Take over the existing project and make sure you understand the current GitHub, Vercel, Supabase, Stripe, Resend, and GoHighLevel setup.
Connect/integrate the platform with our GoHighLevel account.

Move automated SMS from Twilio to our GoHighLevel A2P number.

The previous developer intentionally structured the application so this should be a contained integration rather than a rebuild. The handoff identifies the primary file and functions involved.

Complete our GoHighLevel A2P setup/registration.

I need someone who understands A2P 10DLC and can assist with getting our business, brand, campaign, phone number, and messaging use case properly configured and submitted through GoHighLevel.

Make sure our SMS configuration is compliant and properly set up for our intended customer notifications, including any required opt-in/consent language, STOP/HELP handling, or other requirements needed for A2P approval.
Once A2P is approved/available, connect the approved GHL number to Revenue Credit AI so automated texts originate through GoHighLevel instead of Twilio.
Test the complete SMS process using a test client/account and verify that messages are successfully being sent and appearing correctly inside GoHighLevel Conversations.
Add the required GoHighLevel environment variables/credentials to the production environment and redeploy the application.
Perform a final end-to-end test to make sure the existing platform continues functioning correctly after the integration.
GoHighLevel Transfer

I would also like the developer to review what portions of our current setup should reasonably be managed through GoHighLevel.

I do not want the existing custom Revenue Credit AI platform unnecessarily rebuilt inside GHL. The goal is to properly connect the existing platform to GoHighLevel and use GHL for the functions it is best suited for, including SMS, A2P, conversations, calendars, automations, and CRM functionality where appropriate.

If something should remain in the existing Next.js/Supabase platform, please leave it there.

A2P Experience Is Important

Please do not apply if you have never worked with GoHighLevel A2P 10DLC registration and SMS integrations.

I need someone who understands both the technical API integration and the GHL/A2P account setup side.

If A2P approval itself depends on carrier/third-party review and cannot be guaranteed within the project timeline, I still expect the developer to correctly prepare and submit everything required, resolve any correctable issues, and leave the account ready for approval.

Access Provided

The selected developer will receive the access necessary to complete the project, including:

Existing GitHub repository
Vercel project
Supabase project
Stripe account/configuration as needed
GoHighLevel account/location
Existing developer handoff documentation
Testing documentation
Environment-variable requirements

Passwords and sensitive API credentials will not be posted publicly in the Upwork job description. Access will be provided securely after hiring.

Important Technical Information

The previous developer has already documented the GHL integration.

The current SMS functionality is centralized in:

src/lib/notifications.ts

The existing sendSMS() function currently uses Twilio and needs to be updated to use the appropriate current GoHighLevel/LeadConnector API.

The project already has placeholders for:

GHL_API_KEY

GHL_LOCATION_ID

The developer must verify the current GoHighLevel API documentation and authentication method before implementing the integration rather than relying on outdated endpoints.

The existing email system through Resend should remain in place unless there is a specific reason it needs to be changed.

Two-Way Messaging

GoHighLevel already provides Conversations and message delivery information.

For now, I do not need a completely separate two-way SMS inbox rebuilt inside Revenue Credit AI unless we determine there is a strong reason to do so.

The priority is getting Revenue Credit AI properly connected to GHL so we can manage conversations and SMS through GoHighLevel.

Deliverables

The job will be considered complete when:

Existing project and developer handoff have been reviewed
GoHighLevel connection is properly configured
A2P registration/setup has been completed and submitted correctly
GHL SMS replaces the existing Twilio SMS functionality
Revenue Credit AI can trigger SMS through our GHL setup
Test SMS is successfully triggered from the application when messaging is available
Messages can be verified inside GHL Conversations
Production environment variables are correctly configured
Application is redeployed
Existing major functionality is confirmed to still work
No unnecessary rebuild of the existing platform has occurred
Any changes are committed/pushed to our GitHub repository
I receive a short final handoff explaining exactly what was changed
Budget

Fixed Budget: $200

The core platform is already built, and the previous developer has provided detailed technical documentation specifically designed to make the remaining GHL integration straightforward.

Please review the attached developer handoff before accepting the project so you understand the scope.

When Applying

Please briefly answer the following:

Have you personally completed GoHighLevel A2P 10DLC registrations before?
Have you integrated a custom website/application with the GoHighLevel/LeadConnector API?
Are you comfortable working with Next.js, TypeScript, APIs, Vercel, GitHub, and environment variables?
Can you review and follow an existing developer handoff instead of rebuilding the application?
Can you complete the technical work for the $200 fixed budget?
Please give an example of a similar GHL SMS/API integration you have completed.

Please begin your proposal with the words “REVENUE GHL” so I know you read the entire brief.
